title: ProductWebBench: Evaluating Website Continuity Beyond Task Completion
title_zh: ProductWebBench：超越任务完成的网站连续性评估

paragraphs.en: Frontend coding agents are usually graded on one question: did the requested target get built. Real engineering changes carry a second obligation, because the rest of the site has to keep working. We call that second obligation website continuity , and introduce ProductWebBench , a benchmark that scores both on living frontend repositories: 320 Change tasks over existing code and 80 long-horizon Build tasks. Every task freezes a repository snapshot, staged requirements, browser evidence and deterministic checks before evaluation, and enters only once a reference passes every check and plausible-wrong ones fail. A simulated user reveals the requirements one stage at a time, and every check cleared earlier stays armed for the rest of the run. Across 8,737 runs from 13 models the two come apart: of the Change runs passing every requested-work check, 28.2% still fail a continuity check – a blank route, horizontal overflow, console errors – and 10.8% push a browser state they had already passed back to failing. Because the same checks also run on the untouched repository, each regression carries exact provenance, not a post-hoc label: on the 586 runs where both readings exist, 18.3% are caught breaking a verified state. Interaction is a further blind spot, failing in 29.5% of runs whose static DOM already passes. ProductWebBench therefore scores a patch against the living system it lands in, not the target alone.
paragraphs.zh: 前端编码智能体通常只依据一个问题来评判：请求的目标是否被构建出来。 真实的工程变更还带有第二项义务，因为网站的其他部分必须继续正常工作。 我们将这第二项义务称为网站连续性（website continuity），并介绍 ProductWebBench，一个在活跃前端代码库上进行双项评分的基准：包括针对现有代码的 320 个变更（Change）任务和 80 个长周期构建（Build）任务。 每个任务在评估前都会冻结一个代码库快照、分阶段的需求、浏览器证据和确定性检查，并且只有当参考实现通过所有检查且看似合理的错误实现无法通过时才被收录。 一个模拟用户会逐阶段揭示需求，而每一个此前已通过的检查在后续运行过程中始终保持生效。 在来自 13 个模型的 8,737 次运行中，这两者出现了分化：在通过了所有请求工作检查的变更运行中，仍有 28.2% 未通过某项连续性检查——如空白路由、横向溢出、控制台错误——而 10.8% 的运行将一个它们此前已通过的浏览器状态推回到失败状态。 由于相同的检查也会在未改动的代码库上运行，每一次回归都带有确切的来源依据，而非事后贴上的标签：在同时存在两种读数的 586 次运行中，有 18.3% 被发现破坏了已验证的状态。 交互是另一个盲点，在静态 DOM 已经通过的运行中有 29.5% 在交互上失败。 因此，ProductWebBench 是针对补丁所落地的活跃系统进行评分，而不是只针对目标本身。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly capable of modifying existing software repositories from natural-language instructions, enabling agents to assist with tasks such as feature implementation, bug fixing, and repository-level development. Among these tasks, frontend development has a unique challenge because changes to a user interface often propagate beyond the requested functionality. For example, adding a shopping cart control may require modifications to shared states, checkout flows, responsive layouts, and components across different routes. As a result, a successful frontend agent should not only implement the requested feature, but also preserve the existing behaviors and integrity of the website it modifies.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越有能力根据自然语言指令修改现有软件仓库，使智能体能够协助完成功能实现、缺陷修复和仓库级开发等任务。 在这些任务中，前端开发具有独特的挑战性，因为对用户界面的更改往往会波及到所请求功能之外的范围。 例如，添加一个购物车控件可能需要修改共享状态、结账流程、响应式布局以及不同路由下的组件。 因此，一个成功的前端智能体不仅应实现所请求的功能，还应保持其所修改网站的现有行为和完整性。

paragraphs.en: We refer to this requirement as website continuity . A frontend change can satisfy a local requirement, such as a DOM assertion for the new component, while breaking previously working states, workflows, or visual consistency. Therefore, the unit of success is not the patch alone, but the patch together with the website it lands in. Evaluating such changes requires evidence about the behavior that existed before the modification, not only the final state after the edits (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将这一需求称为「网站连续性」。 前端改动可能满足局部需求，例如针对新组件的 DOM 断言，但同时破坏了原本正常工作的状态、工作流或视觉一致性。 因此，成功的衡量单位不仅仅是补丁本身，而是补丁与其所落入的网站的整体。 评估这类改动需要关于修改之前已有行为的证据，而不仅仅是编辑之后的最终状态（图 1）。

sents.en: We refer to this requirement as website continuity .
sents.zh: 我们将这一需求称为「网站连续性」。

sents.zh: 前端改动可能满足局部需求，例如针对新组件的 DOM 断言，但同时破坏了原本正常工作的状态、工作流或视觉一致性。

sents.zh: 因此，成功的衡量单位不仅仅是补丁本身，而是补丁与其所落入的网站的整体。

sents.en: Evaluating such changes requires evidence about the behavior that existed before the modification, not only the final state after the edits (Figure 1 ).
sents.zh: 评估这类改动需要关于修改之前已有行为的证据，而不仅仅是编辑之后的最终状态（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: This is harder still in long-horizon development, where requirements arrive incrementally and accepted changes become the ground later ones are built on. A later patch may fix a newly requested feature while silently invalidating an earlier browser state, interaction workflow, or cross-page dependency. A continuity evaluation must therefore reason over the evolution of the site: replay established behaviors after subsequent edits, separate newly introduced failures from unresolved existing ones, and hold the acceptance contract stable as requirements evolve.
paragraphs.zh: 这在长周期开发中更为困难，因为需求是逐步到达的，而已被接受的更改会成为后续更改赖以构建的基础。 后续补丁在修复新需求功能的同时，可能会悄然破坏此前的浏览器状态、交互流程或跨页面依赖。 因此，连续性评估必须对网站的演进进行推理：在后续编辑之后重放既有行为，区分新引入的故障与尚未解决的既有故障，并在需求演进过程中保持验收契约的稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Existing benchmarks only cover parts of this problem. Frontend generation benchmarks evaluate whether agents can produce desired interfaces or behaviors ( Si et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) , but they do not measure whether modifications preserve an existing application. Repository-level software engineering benchmarks evaluate code changes against executable tests ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , but lack browser-level evidence involving viewports, interaction histories, and shared frontend components. Browser-agent benchmarks evaluate agents operating on existing websites ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) , but do not study agents that modify the source code defining those websites. None of these settings evaluates whether an agent can continuously improve an existing website while preserving previously established behaviors.
paragraphs.zh: 现有基准测试只覆盖了这一问题的一部分。 前端生成基准评估智能体能否生成期望的界面或行为（Si et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2026），但它们并未衡量修改是否保留了现有应用程序。 仓库级软件工程基准通过可执行测试来评估代码变更（Jimenez et al., 2024），但缺乏涉及视口、交互历史和共享前端组件的浏览器级证据。 浏览器智能体基准评估在现有网站上操作的智能体（Zhou et al., 2024；He et al., 2024），但没有研究修改定义这些网站的源代码的智能体。 这些设置中没有一个能评估智能体能否在保留既有行为的同时持续改进一个现有网站。

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we introduce ProductWebBench , a benchmark for evaluating long-horizon frontend agents under a fixed continuity contract. ProductWebBench contains 320 Change tasks, which evaluate feature modifications and workflow repairs on existing repositories, and 80 Build tasks, which evaluate long-horizon website construction. Each task is constructed from a runnable repository together with captured browser evidence, including routes, viewports, actions, and intermediate states. During evaluation, a capability-conditioned simulated user reveals requirements progressively and provides feedback while the agent modifies a cumulative workspace. This design enables evaluation not only of whether agents complete requested changes, but also whether they preserve the website behaviors established throughout the development process.
paragraphs.zh: 为弥补这一空白，我们提出了ProductWebBench，这是一个在固定连续性契约下评估长周期前端智能体的基准测试。 ProductWebBench包含320个Change任务（评估在现有仓库上的功能修改与工作流修复）和80个Build任务（评估长周期网站构建）。 每个任务由一个可运行的仓库以及采集的浏览器证据构成，包括路由、视口、操作和中间状态。 在评估过程中，一个基于能力条件的模拟用户会逐步揭示需求，并在智能体修改累积工作区的同时提供反馈。 这一设计使评估不仅能衡量智能体是否完成了所请求的更改，还能衡量它们是否保留了在整个开发过程中建立的网站行为。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated 8,737 valid trajectories from 13 models under this protocol. The results reveal a consistent gap between feature completion and website continuity. Among 674 Change runs that satisfy all requested-work checks, 190 ( 28.2% ) still fail our continuity checks. Moreover, 10.8% of these runs regress browser states they had previously passed. Similarly, among 1,322 runs that successfully satisfy the target DOM requirements, 29.5% fail interaction checks. These results show that implementing the requested functionality is only one part of successful frontend development; preserving existing website behavior remains a separate challenge.
paragraphs.zh: 我们根据该协议评估了来自 13 个模型的 8,737 条有效轨迹。 结果显示，功能完成与网站连续性之间存在持续的差距。 在 674 个满足所有要求工作检查的 Change 运行中，有 190 个（28.2%）仍未通过我们的连续性检查。 此外，这些运行中有 10.8% 出现了浏览器状态的退化，尽管其此前已通过相应检查。 类似地，在 1,322 个成功满足目标 DOM 要求的运行中，有 29.5% 未通过交互检查。 这些结果表明，实现所要求的功能只是成功前端开发的一部分；保持现有的网站行为仍然是一个单独的挑战。

sents.zh: 我们根据该协议评估了来自 13 个模型的 8,737 条有效轨迹。

sents.en: These results show that implementing the requested functionality is only one part of successful frontend development; preserving existing website behavior remains a separate challenge.

paragraphs.en: We summarize our contributions as follows: ❶ An acceptance contract testable before any solver runs. Each of the 400 tasks is admitted only once its reference passes every gate and authored wrong solutions fail, so satisfiability and gate discrimination are settled before evaluation, not argued after it. ❷ Long-horizon runs with cumulative gates. A simulated user reveals the task one stage at a time, and a cleared stage is never retired: its assertions stay armed at every later checkpoint, so continuity is scored across the whole trajectory, not its endpoint. ❸ Two regression channels with exact provenance. A state the run was seen to pass, and a gate the untouched repository satisfied, are two routes to a regression no labelling step has to guess at, and they are nearly disjoint. Their union catches 18.3 % \mathbf{18.3\%} [ 15.3 % 15.3\% , 21.6 % 21.6\% ] of the 586 covered completing runs damaging a verified state; 13.3 % 13.3\% are caught and still failing a continuity check at the end.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：❶ 一份在任何求解器运行之前即可测试的验收契约。 400 个任务中的每一个，只有在其参考解通过每一道关卡且人工编写的错误解全部失败后才会被收录，因此可满足性与关卡区分能力在评估之前就已确定，而不是在评估之后再行争论。❷ 带有累积关卡的长时间跨度运行。 模拟用户每次只揭示一个阶段的任务，而已通关的阶段绝不会退役：其断言在之后每个检查点都保持生效，因此连续性是在整个轨迹上评分，而不是只看终点。❸ 两条具有精确溯源的回归通道。 运行中被观察到已通过的状态，以及未改动仓库曾满足的关卡，是通向回归的两条路径，无需任何标注步骤去猜测，而且这两条路径几乎互不相交。 它们的并集捕获了 586 个已覆盖的完成运行中损害已验证状态的 18.3 % \mathbf{18.3\%} [ 15.3 % 15.3\% , 21.6 % 21.6\% ]；其中 13.3 % 13.3\% 被捕获且在结束时仍未通过连续性检查。

sents.en: We summarize our contributions as follows: ❶ An acceptance contract testable before any solver runs.
sents.zh: 我们将我们的贡献总结如下：❶ 一份在任何求解器运行之前即可测试的验收契约。

sents.en: Each of the 400 tasks is admitted only once its reference passes every gate and authored wrong solutions fail, so satisfiability and gate discrimination are settled before evaluation, not argued after it. ❷ Long-horizon runs with cumulative gates.

sents.en: A simulated user reveals the task one stage at a time, and a cleared stage is never retired: its assertions stay armed at every later checkpoint, so continuity is scored across the whole trajectory, not its endpoint. ❸ Two regression channels with exact provenance.

paragraphs.en: Task regimes and coverage. The locked suite contains 400 tasks in two regimes. The 320 Change tasks begin from a runnable repository and ask the agent to modify it while preserving incumbent behavior; the 80 Build tasks grow a product site through 5 to 14 ordered milestones, a construction and long-horizon regime rather than an easy control for Change. Each Change task is organized around one facet – the place where continuity can break: state, design, experience, content and assets, regression or implementation – and the facet fixes which evidence has to survive the change. Every candidate repository is installed, built, served and exercised before authoring, and what cannot be reproduced or legally packaged never enters the pool; the inventory spans React, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Gatsby, Hugo, PHP and static sites. Appendix A gives the capability labels and the full facet inventory, and Appendix F the finer framework breakdown.
paragraphs.zh: 任务机制与覆盖范围。 锁定的任务套件包含两种机制下的 400 个任务。 其中 320 个 Change（变更）任务从一个可运行的仓库出发，要求智能体在保留既有行为的前提下对其进行修改；80 个 Build（构建）任务则通过 5 到 14 个有序里程碑逐步扩展一个产品站点，这是一种构建型长周期机制，而非 Change 的简单对照组。 每个 Change 任务围绕一个切面组织——即连续性可能中断之处：状态、设计、体验、内容与资产、回归或实现——该切面决定了哪些证据必须在变更后得以保留。 每个候选仓库在编写任务前都会经过安装、构建、部署和实际运行验证，无法复现或无法合法打包的仓库不会进入任务池；这些仓库涵盖 React、Vue、Svelte、Astro、Gatsby、Hugo、PHP 以及静态站点。 附录 A 给出能力标签和完整的切面清单，附录 F 给出更细粒度的框架分类。

paragraphs.en: The request is then grounded in E E : design requirements point to repository-native assets and tokens, behavior requirements name a route, viewport, action prefix and expected state, and preservation requirements identify untouched states sharing navigation, data, styling or source files with the target. Those states compile into regression gates replayed at every checkpoint, and the plan S S follows the dependency structure in the evidence, so a cart task exposes route access, item state, a new control, cross-page persistence, responsive behavior and regression replay, one per turn.
paragraphs.zh: 随后将请求落地于 E E：设计需求指向仓库原生的资产与设计令牌，行为需求指明路由、视口、操作前缀与预期状态，而保留需求则识别出与目标共享导航、数据、样式或源文件且未受改动的状态。 这些状态会被编译为在每个检查点重放的回归门禁，且计划 S S 遵循证据中的依赖结构，因此一个购物车任务会依次展现路由访问、商品状态、新控件、跨页面持久化、响应式行为与回归重放，每轮各一项。

paragraphs.en: Once authored, the fields of 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} are frozen together, so changing the solver or the conversation that presents a task never changes its acceptance checks or the evidence behind them. Admission then tests whether the package discriminates the intended behavior: applying Δ ⋆ \Delta^{\star} to R 0 R_{0} must pass every applicable check, and plausible wrong implementations in N N must fail: a visually convincing control with inert state, a responsive layout that overflows at one viewport, a local edit that drops an existing route. One more property is observed, not asserted: the task must not already be done. Of the 234 slots whose untouched repository renders under the frozen toolchain, the repository handed to the solver passes every gate on 0 of them, the closest reaching 17 / 19 17/19 . On every one of them, then, the requested work is measurably outstanding when the solver starts. Section 4 reports how the authoring pool scores on both halves of this test, and Appendix D the audit behind them.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦编写完成，𝒬 \mathcal{Q} 的字段就被整体冻结，因此更换求解器或更改呈现任务的对话，都不会改变其验收检查项或这些检查背后的证据。 随后准入测试检验该包是否能够区分目标行为：将 Δ ⋆ \Delta^{\star} 应用于 R 0 R_{0} 必须通过所有适用的检查，而 N N 中看似合理的错误实现必须失败：例如一个状态僵死的视觉上令人信服的控件、一个在某一视口宽度下溢出的响应式布局、一个丢失既有路由的局部编辑。 还有一个性质是被观测到而非被断言的：任务必须尚未完成。 在冻结工具链下其未改动仓库能够渲染的 234 个槽位中，交给求解器的仓库在 0 个槽位上通过所有门控，最接近的也只达到 17 / 19 17/19 。 因此，在每一个这样的槽位上，当求解器开始工作时，所请求的工作都是可测量地尚未完成的。 第 4 节报告了编写池在这项测试的两半上的得分，附录 D 则报告了其背后的审计。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation starts from R 0 R_{0} and walks the stage plan S S of Eq. 1 . One simulated user presents the work, the solver edits a cumulative workspace, and the harness checks the result against the frozen checks G G (Figure 3 ). One design choice does most of the work: clearing a milestone does not retire it. Every assertion a stage clears becomes a standing obligation retested after every later edit, so the score reflects the whole trajectory and not just the state reached at the final turn.
paragraphs.zh: 评估从 R 0 R_{0} 出发，沿着式 1 的阶段计划 S S 进行。 一个模拟用户展示工作，求解器编辑一个累积的工作区，而测试框架将结果与冻结的检查 G G 进行比对（图 3）。 有一个设计选择起到了大部分作用：完成一个里程碑并不意味着将其退役。 每个阶段通过的断言都成为一项长期义务，在之后的每次编辑后都会被重新测试，因此分数反映的是整个轨迹，而不仅仅是最后一轮达到的状态。

paragraphs.en: Two interfaces read the same frozen package: the staged regime reveals it as a sequence of work units, the full-spec regime hands the agent everything at once. Every model result is staged, while the agent-scaffold study uses full-spec because CLI agents own their turn loop, so the two arms are reported separately and never compared. In the staged regime each task selects a persona from its capability (PM for Build and Edit, QA for Repair, designer for Consistency), and the persona controls only the wording that reveals work units authored in advance. It does not generate requirements, read the reference patch, edit the verifier or decide pass/fail, and reveal, solver, checkpoint and pushback events are logged separately (Appendix C ).
paragraphs.zh: 两个接口读取同一个冻结的软件包：分阶段模式将其呈现为一系列工作单元，而全规格模式则一次性把所有内容交给智能体。 每个模型结果都是分阶段呈现的，而智能体脚手架研究使用全规格模式，因为命令行界面（CLI）智能体拥有自己的回合循环，因此两条实验线分开报告，从不进行比较。 在分阶段模式中，每个任务根据其能力选择一个人设（Build 和 Edit 用产品经理，Repair 用测试工程师，Consistency 用设计师），该人设仅控制用于揭示预先撰写好的工作单元的措辞。 它不生成需求、不阅读参考补丁、不编辑验证器，也不判定通过与否，并且揭示、求解器、检查点和回推事件分别记录（见附录 C）。

paragraphs.en: Three success notions recur and are not interchangeable. Requested-work completion means every completion-family gate passes. Final gate pass means all nineteen gates pass on the final workspace, which 259 of the 8,737 cells reach; it is the v i v_{i} of Eq. 3 and what the full-spec scaffold arm reports, since that arm verifies only once. Whole-task pass additionally requires every stage and rework to clear with b i = 0 b_{i}=0 . It is the stricter notion, it holds on 198 cells, and it is the Task% column of Table 1 . Case (1) in Appendix J passes all nineteen final gates on its delivered workspace without clearing every unit, which is exactly the gap between the second notion and the third.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate 13 frontier and open coding models under the staged protocol of Section 3 : every run starts from a pristine repository with the same stage plan, gates, allowed paths and budgets, cannot reach the reference or the negative controls, and is checked by the frozen 19-gate verifier at every checkpoint. Nine of the 13 also have image-valid screenshot runs paired with their own text-only cells. A verdict counts only if it postdates its task’s frozen specification, leaving 8,737 live cells , 6,979 Change and 1,758 Build, the single snapshot every number in this paper is computed from. Before interpreting any model failure we check that the benchmark can separate a correct solution from a plausible regression: across the validated authoring pool all 479 reference implementations pass and all 479 smart-wrong controls fail, Wilson [0.992, 1.000] in both directions. That is an admission property of the pool, not an accuracy estimate on unseen solver output. What it rules out is that a low score comes from an impossible reference, or a gate that lets the authored bad state through: the contract discriminates before any model runs. Appendix F gives the models, per-question denominators and statistical conventions, and Appendix D measures accuracy on solver output.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在第3节的分阶段协议下评估13个前沿与开源编程模型：每次运行都从一个干净的代码仓库出发，遵循相同的阶段计划、门控、允许路径和预算，无法接触参考实现或负面对照，并且在每个检查点都由冻结的19门验证器进行检查。 这13个模型中有9个还拥有与各自纯文本单元配对的图像有效截图运行。 只有在其任务冻结规范之后做出的判定才计入，共留下8,737个有效单元，其中6,979个为Change、1,758个为Build，这是本文所有数字计算所依据的单一快照。 在解释任何模型失败之前，我们先检查基准能否将正确解与看似合理的回归区分开来：在经过验证的创作池中，全部479个参考实现均通过，全部479个“聪明但错误”对照均失败，双向Wilson区间均为[0.992, 1.000]。 这是创作池的一种准入性质，而不是对未见过的求解器输出的准确率估计。 它排除的是以下情况：低分来自一个不可实现的参考实现，或来自一个放行了人为构造的坏状态的门控：即契约在任何模型运行之前就具备区分能力。 附录F给出了模型、每个问题的分母和统计约定，附录D则测量求解器输出上的准确率。

Only 198 of the 8,737 cells clear every stage and rework, pass every gate, and record no regression break, and whole-task rates span 1.25 1.25 to 3.50 % 3.50\% , too narrow a band to order the field. Gate% spans 49.41 49.41 to 61.71 61.71 over the same runs and does order it, and the two disagree at the top: Claude-Opus-4.8 leads whole-task success while GPT-5.5 leads Gate% and Stage%. By capability the ordering is the same for all 13 models, Repair highest and Consistency lowest of the three Change capabilities, which asks a change to match conventions that live in the repository rather than in the request.

paragraphs.en: Scaffolds change the number as much as backbones do. Table 4 runs eight distinct scaffolds over the same 400 tasks, four of them under both backbones, so scaffold and backbone can be compared as one statistic rather than a range against a mean. On that matched 4 × 2 4\times 2 grid, swapping the scaffold under a fixed backbone moves the component mean by 8.06 8.06 pt on Sonnet-4.6 and 10.52 10.52 pt on GPT-5.5, while swapping the backbone under a fixed scaffold moves it by 5.08 5.08 pt. How an agent is wired around a model therefore matters as much as which model it is, which is a reason to report the scaffold with the score (Appendix F defines the component mean and states what this matched grid does and does not control).
paragraphs.zh: 脚手架对数值的改变幅度与底层模型相当。 表 4 在相同的 400 个任务上运行了八种不同的脚手架，其中四种在两个底层模型下都进行了测试，因此脚手架与底层模型可以作为同一统计量进行比较，而不是用区间去对比均值。 在这个 4 × 2 4\times 2 的匹配网格上，在固定底层模型的情况下更换脚手架，会使组件均值在 Sonnet-4.6 上移动 8.06 8.06 pt，在 GPT-5.5 上移动 10.52 10.52 pt；而在固定脚手架的情况下更换底层模型，则使其移动 5.08 5.08 pt。 因此，智能体如何围绕一个模型进行构建，与其使用哪个模型同等重要，这也是在报告分数时应同时报告脚手架的原因（附录 F 定义了组件均值，并说明了该匹配网格控制了哪些因素、未控制哪些因素）。

sents.zh: 脚手架对数值的改变幅度与底层模型相当。

sents.en: On that matched 4 × 2 4\times 2 grid, swapping the scaffold under a fixed backbone moves the component mean by 8.06 8.06 pt on Sonnet-4.6 and 10.52 10.52 pt on GPT-5.5, while swapping the backbone under a fixed scaffold moves it by 5.08 5.08 pt.
sents.zh: 在这个 4 × 2 4\times 2 的匹配网格上，在固定底层模型的情况下更换脚手架，会使组件均值在 Sonnet-4.6 上移动 8.06 8.06 pt，在 GPT-5.5 上移动 10.52 10.52 pt；而在固定脚手架的情况下更换底层模型，则使其移动 5.08 5.08 pt。

sents.en: How an agent is wired around a model therefore matters as much as which model it is, which is a reason to report the scaffold with the score (Appendix F defines the component mean and states what this matched grid does and does not control).

Completion is not continuity. Table 3 separates the two verdicts: of the Change runs that pass every completion-family gate, 28.2 % \mathbf{28.2\%} still fail at least one continuity check, rising to 64.1% under the broad visual-inclusive reading. Every model shows it (Figure 4 ; Appendix E gives the intervals and the per-model spread). Nor are these runs failing for want of a patch that applies: 98.3% of failing cells land at least one edit. And an element being present does not make it work: on the interactive cells whose static DOM requirement already passes, interaction assertions still fail 29.5% of the time (Table 12 ; Appendix F ).

paragraphs.en: Two regression channels with exact provenance. One channel needs no target-versus-prior labelling at all: whenever a stage clears, its assertions enter a protected set the harness replays at every later checkpoint of the same run (Section 3 ), so an assertion that passes at stage k k and fails at k ′ > k k^{\prime}>k is a pass-to-fail transition on a state the run itself established. Among completing runs this fires on 10.8 % \mathbf{10.8\%} . That set can only hold states a run established itself, so for the complementary class we captured each repository as handed to the solver and ran the same frozen suite on it: a gate the untouched repository passes and the final workspace fails is a regression with exact provenance whether or not the run asserted it. It fires on 43.9% of covered Change runs, no model escapes, and the rate falls as model quality rises (Spearman ρ = − 0.88 \rho=-0.88 against mean WCS). What it catches is ordinary product health: horizontal overflow, a route that stops rendering, console errors. On the runs where both channels can be read they are close in size and nearly disjoint, so together 18.3% are caught damaging a state that was verified working and 13.3 % \mathbf{13.3\%} are both caught and still failing a conservative check at the end: the first speaks to trajectories, the second to delivered sites. Neither restates the post-completion gap (Figure 5 and Table 4 ; Appendix E gives the coverage, the residual cases and the gates each channel rests on, which bounds the claim).
paragraphs.zh: 两条回归通道，出处完全可考。 其中一条通道完全不需要目标与先验的对比标注：每当一个阶段通过，其断言就进入一个受保护的集合，评测框架会在同一次运行的后续每个检查点重放该集合（第 3 节），因此一条在阶段 k k 通过、在 k ′ > k k^{\prime}>k 失败的断言，就是在运行自身建立的状态上发生的一次由通过转为失败的转变。 在完成的运行中，这一比例为 10.8 % \mathbf{10.8\%} 。 该集合只能保存运行自身建立的状态，因此对于互补的那一类，我们把每个仓库按交付给智能体时的原样捕获，并在其上运行同一套冻结的测试套件：未被改动的仓库能通过而最终工作区却失败的门槛检查，无论运行是否断言过，都是一条出处完全可考的回归。 它在被覆盖的 Change 运行中有 43.9% 触发，没有任何模型能够幸免，且该比率随模型质量提升而下降（与平均 WCS 的 Spearman ρ = − 0.88 \rho=-0.88 ）。 它所捕捉的是寻常的产品健康问题：横向溢出、停止渲染的路由、控制台报错。 在两条通道都可解读的运行中，二者规模相近且几乎不相交，因此合计有 18.3% 的运行被发现损坏了某个已验证可用的状态，而 13.3 % \mathbf{13.3\%} 的运行既被捕捉到、最终仍未通过一项保守检查：前者针对轨迹，后者针对交付的站点。 二者都未重述完成后的差距（图 5 和表 4；附录 E 给出了覆盖率、剩余案例以及每条通道所依据的门槛检查，这为该结论划定了边界）。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon construction. Build and Change occupy different regimes: on the nine-model dual-modal panel pooled Build WCS is 0.240 against 0.348 for Change, the gap sits in stage completion, not gate quality, and Build plans are the longer ones (Table 12 ). Longer runs are not recovering ones: on Build tasks of at least seven stages the correlation between turns and stages cleared is negative in every stage-count bucket, median − 0.91 -0.91 , because cleared units finish fast while a failed one burns all 12 turns (Figure 9 ; Appendix H covers the stopping rule). Creation is also harder than the matched in-place change. Because Build plans are longer, the pooled gap alone cannot separate regime from trajectory length, so we settle it with an authored twin study: twenty-one Change tasks duplicated as greenfield twins that reach the same end state from an empty baseline, on the same site, under identical acceptance gates and with stage counts matched by construction. Across the 105 paired cells the pooled twin − - source Δ ​ WCS \Delta\mathrm{WCS} is − 11.82 -11.82 points on the 100 × 100\times WCS scale ( t = − 4.74 t=-4.74 ), with all five model-legs negative. The two regimes are related but not interchangeable, and the capability slices do not order the field identically either: ranking the 13 models by Gate% within each capability, GPT-5.5 leads Edit, Consistency and Build while GLM-5.2-FP8 leads Repair (Figures 6 and 10 ; Appendix F reports the rank coherence across the four slices, which is high but not uniform).
paragraphs.zh: 长程构建。 Build（构建）与 Change（变更）处于不同的状态区间：在九个模型的双模态面板上，汇总的 Build WCS 为 0.240，而 Change 为 0.348，差距出现在阶段完成环节，而非门控质量，且 Build 的规划更长（表 12）。 更长的运行并不意味着更多的恢复：在至少七个阶段的 Build 任务上，回合数与已清除阶段数之间的相关性在每个阶段数分桶中均为负值，中位数为 −0.91，因为已清除单元会快速完成，而失败单元则会耗尽全部 12 个回合（图 9；附录 H 说明了停止规则）。 创造也比匹配的就地变更更难。 由于 Build 规划更长，仅凭汇总差距无法将状态区间与轨迹长度区分开来，因此我们通过一项精心设计的孪生研究来解决这个问题：将二十一个 Change 任务复制为绿地孪生任务，即从空基线出发、在相同站点上、在完全相同的验收门控下、并以刻意匹配的阶段数，到达相同的最终状态。 在 105 个配对单元格中，汇总的孪生任务相对源任务的 Δ WCS 在 100 × WCS 尺度上为 −11.82 分（t = −4.74），且五个模型腿全部为负。 这两种状态区间相关但不可互换，而且各能力切片对各家模型的排序也不尽相同：在每个能力内按 Gate% 对 13 个模型进行排名，GPT-5.5 领先于 Edit（编辑）、Consistency（一致性）和 Build（构建），而 GLM-5.2-FP8 领先于 Repair（修复）（图 6 和图 10；附录 F 报告了四个切片之间的排名一致性，该一致性较高但并不完全一致）。

paragraphs.en: What moves the continuity signal. Capability does not track protected-state regression here: ranking the 13 models by Gate% and by the share of their completing runs that break a protected state gives two orderings with no detectable relation at this sample size (Spearman ρ = − 0.02 \rho=-0.02 , p = 0.96 p=0.96 ; Figure 4 b), and the strongest model on Gate% carries the highest regression rate of all. What does move the graded gate rate is prompt scale, in both directions. Truncating the solver’s history to five turns drops Gate% by 9.40 9.40 points while stage completion and turn count are essentially unchanged, so the solver reaches the same stages and does worse work at them. Adding a “do not break unrelated behavior; keep everything else byte-for-byte” clause lifts Gate% by 7.81 7.81 pt without costing a whole-task pass (Figure 7 ). The simulated user is not doing the solver’s work: changing what it says, in either direction, moves nothing distinguishable from zero, and neither does the edit format nor giving the solver screenshots. What the solver is told moves the score; what it is shown, and how the request is worded, do not. Appendix F tabulates these arms with the solver-vision contrast Figure 7 leaves out, and Appendix E the endpoint these arms cannot resolve.
paragraphs.zh: 什么会移动连续性信号。 在这里，能力并不与受保护状态的回归率对应：按 Gate% 以及按其完成运行中破坏受保护状态的比例对 13 个模型进行排序，在当前样本量下得到两种没有可检测关系的排序（Spearman ρ = − 0.02 \rho=-0.02，p = 0.96 p=0.96；图 4 b），而且在 Gate% 上最强的模型却具有所有模型中最高的回归率。 真正会移动分级门限通过率的是提示规模，而且是双向的。 将智能体的历史截断为五轮会使 Gate% 下降 9.40 9.40 个百分点，而阶段完成率和轮数基本不变，因此智能体到达了相同的阶段，却在这些阶段中做得更差。 增加一条“不要破坏无关行为；其余内容保持逐字节不变”的条款，可使 Gate% 提升 7.81 7.81 个百分点，而不损失整任务通过率（图 7）。 模拟用户并没有替智能体完成工作：无论朝哪个方向改变其所说内容，产生的变化都无法与零区分开，编辑格式以及给智能体提供截图也同样如此。 告诉智能体的内容会移动分数；而展示给它的内容以及请求的措辞方式则不会。 附录 F 列出了这些实验臂，并补充了图 7 未包含的智能体视觉对比，附录 E 则列出了这些实验臂无法分辨的端点。

paragraphs.en: Frontend and repository benchmarks. Benchmarks connect webpage designs with code generation and visual reconstruction ( Si et al., 2025 ; Yun et al., 2024 ; Gui et al., 2025 ) , then expand to framework-based editing and repair ( Xiao et al., 2025 ) and to the functional, visual and interactive quality of generated applications ( Zhang et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . Closest in coverage, WebCompass unifies text-, image- and video-conditioned generation, editing and repair, judging edits by model and generation by browser agent ( Lei et al., 2026 ) . SWE-bench evaluates issue resolution with executable tests, regression tests included ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) , and SWE-bench Multimodal extends it to visual, user-facing JavaScript software ( Yang et al., 2025 ) ; agent interfaces and execution platforms support editing and adaptation to observations ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , and complementary work studies refinement, reflection and the limits of self-repair ( Madaan et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ; Olausson et al., 2024 ) . Lifecycle coverage, executable feedback and preservation checks are shared concerns.

paragraphs.en: Browser environments, simulated users, and what ProductWebBench adds. Web-agent research contributes demonstrations, executable environments and grounded tasks ( Deng et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Koh et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2024 ) , OSWorld covers desktop and cross-application workflows ( Xie et al., 2024 ) , ReAct studies interleaved reasoning and action ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , AgentBoard measures intermediate progress ( Ma et al., 2024 ) , and simulated-user benchmarks examine tool use against verifiable outcomes ( Yao et al., 2024 ; Barres et al., 2025 ) . What ProductWebBench adds is cumulative verification under a frozen contract. A task package binds each requirement to route, viewport and action-history evidence; a simulated user stages the work while frozen checks decide acceptance; and every cleared state is replayed at every later checkpoint, so an edit is graded against the site it changes, not the target alone. One trajectory therefore yields requested completion, additional verification failure and provenance-exact regression as three separate quantities, so progress, persistent failure and damage are told apart, not inferred from repair turns.
paragraphs.zh: 浏览器环境、模拟用户，以及 ProductWebBench 的贡献。 Web 智能体研究提供了演示、可执行环境和有依据的任务（Deng et al., 2023；Zhou et al., 2024；Koh et al., 2024；He et al., 2024），OSWorld 覆盖桌面与跨应用工作流（Xie et al., 2024），ReAct 研究推理与动作的交错执行（Yao et al., 2023），AgentBoard 衡量中间进展（Ma et al., 2024），而模拟用户基准则针对可验证结果考察工具使用（Yao et al., 2024；Barres et al., 2025）。 ProductWebBench 的贡献在于在冻结契约下的累积验证。 任务包将每条需求绑定到路由、视口和动作历史证据；模拟用户分阶段推进工作，而冻结的检查决定验收；并且每个已通过的状态都会在之后的每个检查点被重放，因此一次修改是针对它所改变的整个网站评分，而不是只针对目标本身。 因此，一条轨迹可以产出三个相互独立的量：所请求任务的完成情况、额外验证失败以及来源精确的回归，从而将进展、持续失败与损害区分开来，而不是从修复轮次中推断。

paragraphs.en: ProductWebBench evaluates frontend patches against a living system, not an isolated target. Its 400 evidence-backed tasks combine real repositories, staged persona-conditioned interaction, cumulative browser checkpoints and validated verifiers. Across 13 models, 28.2% of the Change runs that pass every completion gate still fail an additional conservative check. Protected-state replay certifies 10.8% of them as pass-to-fail regressions on states the run established itself, and the untouched-repository channel raises provenance-exact damage to 18.3% on the 586 runs where both are observable, with 13.3% of that same 586 still failing a conservative check at the end. Scaffolds matter as much as backbones: on the full-spec arm, swapping the scaffold under a fixed backbone moves the score further than the reverse, so the harness belongs in any report of agent capability. Target completion alone is therefore insufficient evidence that the site the change lands in still holds. Appendix G draws out what these numbers imply for reporting, Appendix H bounds the claims, and Appendix J walks seven released trajectories end to end, one per capability.
paragraphs.zh: ProductWebBench 在一个活系统中评估前端补丁，而非针对孤立目标。 其 400 个有证据支撑的任务结合了真实代码库、分阶段的角色条件交互、累积式浏览器检查点以及经过验证的校验器。 在 13 个模型中，28.2% 通过全部完成门控的 Change 运行仍然未能通过一项额外的保守检查。 受保护状态重放将其中的 10.8% 认证为在运行自身建立的状态上从通过变为失败的回归，而在可同时观测两者的 586 个运行中，未改动代码库通道将来源精确的损害提升至 18.3%，且同一 586 个运行中仍有 13.3% 在结尾未能通过保守检查。 脚手架与骨干模型同等重要：在完整规格分支上，在固定骨干下更换脚手架对分数的影响比反向操作更大，因此评测框架应包含在任何智能体能力报告中。 因此，仅达成目标完成并不足以证明变更所落地的站点仍然完好。 附录 G 阐述这些数字对报告工作的含义，附录 H 界定相关论断的边界，附录 J 则逐一完整走查七条已发布的轨迹，每项能力各一条。

paragraphs.en: This work evaluates code-generating agents on software repositories and involves no human subjects, no personal data, and no user studies. Every task is built from a publicly available frontend repository, and each released package retains the upstream repository’s provenance and license; we redistribute task metadata, browser-state evidence, and verifier definitions rather than relicensed source. Evaluation runs in a sandboxed workspace with no deployment to public services and no production credentials, and provider keys, billing metadata, and transient workspaces are excluded from the release (Appendix I ). The benchmark measures whether a patch preserves behaviour that a repository already had; it is a software-quality instrument and we are not aware of a dual-use risk beyond that of the public repositories it is built from. The scores we report describe systems under one fixed protocol and should not be read as general capability claims about any vendor’s model, and we state throughout where provider availability makes model coverage unbalanced.
paragraphs.zh: 本工作在软件仓库上评估代码生成智能体，不涉及人类受试者、个人数据或用户研究。 每个任务均基于公开可用的前端仓库构建，每个发布的包都保留上游仓库的来源与许可证；我们重新分发的是任务元数据、浏览器状态证据和校验器定义，而非重新授权的源代码。 评估在沙箱化工作区中运行，不部署到公共服务，也不使用生产环境凭据；提供商密钥、计费元数据和临时工作区均被排除在发布之外（附录 I）。 该基准衡量的是一个补丁是否保留了仓库已有的行为；它是一种软件质量工具，除其构建所依据的公开仓库本身的风险外，我们不知道存在其他两用风险。 我们报告的分数描述的是在单一固定协议下的系统表现，不应被解读为对任何厂商模型的通用能力声明，并且我们在全文中说明了提供商可用性导致模型覆盖不均衡之处。

paragraphs.en: Every number in the paper is computed from one frozen result manifest, and that manifest is what we release: one row per evaluated cell, carrying the stage and gate components of the score, the applied and rejected edits, the failing gates, and the normalized capability, facet and framework labels. Rows superseded by a later submission specification are already removed from it, so the released manifest is exactly the 8,737 cells every number is taken over. Section 4 fixes the protocol, budgets, and stale-row filter; Appendix B gives the gate families, Appendix C the two evaluation arms and their scoring conventions, Appendix D the verifier-validation procedure, and Appendix E the exact definition of both continuity statistics. Appendix I lists what each released task package contains and the safeguards applied before release. Rerun variability is characterised in Appendix D : the graded metric carries a per-cell noise floor of σ ≈ 0.09 \sigma\approx 0.09 , which we quantify and attach to every graded number, so exact per-cell reproduction of a graded score should not be expected even at T = 0 T=0 ; the binary verdict was stable in all fifteen replayed pairs.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中的每一个数字都由一份冻结的结果清单计算得出，而我们要发布的正是这份清单：每个被评估的单元对应一行，其中包含得分的阶段与门控分量、已应用和被拒绝的编辑、未通过的门控，以及规范化的能力、侧面与框架标签。 被后续提交规范所取代的行已从中移除，因此发布的清单恰好就是所有数字所依据的 8,737 个单元。 第 4 节规定了协议、预算与过期行过滤器；附录 B 给出门控类别，附录 C 给出两种评估分支及其计分约定，附录 D 给出验证器校验流程，附录 E 给出两个连续性统计量的精确定义。 附录 I 列出了每个已发布任务包所包含的内容以及发布前采取的防护措施。 重跑的变异性在附录 D 中加以刻画：分级指标带有每单元 σ ≈ 0.09 \sigma\approx 0.09 的噪声底线，我们对它进行了量化并将其附于每一个分级数字之上，因此即便在 T = 0 T=0 时，也不应期望分级得分在单元级别上完全复现；二元的判定结果在全部十五对重放中都是稳定的。

paragraphs.en: The decomposition into completion and additional verification is computed from names emitted by the frozen verifier, not from post hoc labeling. Table 6 lists the families used in the reported analysis. visual_regression is held out of the conservative family throughout because it compares against a reference render without controlling scroll offset, so target-versus-prior provenance is not uniform across its failures. One completion signal, state_url_signals , is configured by no task in the locked suite and so passes on every cell; we keep it in the table because the verifier emits it and Gate% is divided by 19 throughout. Recomputing Gate% over the eighteen signals that can fail lowers every model by two to three points and leaves the ordering in Table 1 unchanged.
paragraphs.zh: 完成与额外验证的划分是根据冻结的验证器所输出的名称计算的，而非来自事后标注。 表6列出了所报告分析中使用的家族。visual_regression 在整个保守家族中始终被排除在外，因为它在与参考渲染进行比较时未控制滚动偏移，因此其失败中目标与先前的来源并不一致。 有一个完成信号 state_url_signals 未被锁定套件中的任何任务配置，因此在每个单元格上都会通过；我们将其保留在表中是因为验证器会输出它，且 Gate% 在全文中始终除以 19。 在十八个可能失败的信号上重新计算 Gate% 会使每个模型降低两到三个百分点，且表1中的排序保持不变。

paragraphs.en: The simulated user is an evaluation interface, and deliberately so: one capability-conditioned persona per task, revealing requirements authored in advance and grounded feedback while acceptance stays fixed. That separation is what makes runs comparable across thirteen models. Multi-role interaction is a natural extension and belongs on the same frozen states and gates.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟用户是一个评估接口，而且是刻意为之：每个任务对应一个由能力条件定义的角色，揭示预先编写好的需求和有依据的反馈，同时验收标准保持固定。 正是这种分离使得各次运行可以在十三个模型之间进行比较。 多角色交互是一种自然的扩展，应归属于同样的冻结状态与门控机制。

paragraphs.en: Scaffold and staged scores are therefore not comparable as model-quality estimates. Gate% in Table 4 runs well above Table 1 while strict Task% runs below it, for reasons that have nothing to do with agent quality: a full-spec agent is graded once, against the final requirement set, without ever having to hold an earlier state passing. The two Task% columns are not the same quantity either: the scaffold arm reports a final gate pass, the staged arm the stricter whole-task notion of Section 3 . That is precisely the difficulty the staged interface adds, and why we read the scaffold study as an internal comparison rather than a second leaderboard.

paragraphs.en: Admission fixes the acceptance contract before any solver is run. All 479 references pass every gate and all 479 authored bad solutions fail, and the Build controls additionally pass the empty-baseline, self-certification, distinct-artifact and stage-solvability checks. That is true by construction, because a task enters the pool only when its contract is demonstrably satisfiable and its plausible failure mode is demonstrably caught, and it is exactly the guarantee we need: before a solver runs, two construction failures are already ruled out, a reference that cannot satisfy its own contract, and a gate that waves the authored regression through. Accuracy on unseen solver output is a separate question, and we measure it directly on real sweep output below.
paragraphs.zh: 准入在任何求解器运行之前就固定了验收契约。 全部 479 个参考解通过每一道关卡，全部 479 个人工编写的坏解都失败，此外 Build 控制组还额外通过了空基线、自认证、去重工件和阶段可解性检查。 这一点由构造方式保证，因为一个任务只有在其契约被证明可满足、且其可能的失败模式被证明能被捕获时才会进入池中；而这正是我们需要的确切保证：在求解器运行之前，两类构造性失败已被排除——无法满足自身契约的参考解，以及放行人工编写的回归解的关卡。 在未见过的求解器输出上的准确性是另一个问题，我们在下文直接在真实的扫描输出上对其进行测量。

paragraphs.en: Blind model audit on solver output. We drew 720 stratified (cell, gate) verdicts from the actual sweep and rejudged each one from evidence alone. Rater A is the deterministic auto-rater; Rater B is ten blind shards of a frontier model that see the captured DOM, screenshot, and console log for the state in question, together with the assertion text, but never the gate implementation, the reference patch, or the verifier’s own verdict. On the n = 359 n=359 subset where both raters commit, they agree 94.2 % 94.2\% of the time at Cohen κ = 0.820 \kappa=0.820 . Rater A abstains by design on gates whose evidence lies outside the blind bundle, so the committed subset is the informative one. Against the A/B consensus label ( n = 338 n=338 ) the frozen verifier reaches κ = 0.766 \kappa=0.766 , with a false-pass rate of 0.044 0.044 [ 0.025 0.025 , 0.075 0.075 ] and a false-fail rate of 0.190 0.190 . Stratified by capability, κ \kappa is 0.862 0.862 on Edit ( n = 114 n=114 ), 0.791 0.791 on Consistency ( n = 117 n=117 ), and 0.657 0.657 on Repair ( n = 107 n=107 ); by family it is 0.772 0.772 on completion ( n = 240 n=240 ) and 0.711 0.711 on continuity ( n = 98 n=98 ).
paragraphs.zh: 对求解器输出的盲审模型审计。 我们从实际扫描中抽取了 720 个分层（cell, gate）判定，并仅凭证据对每一个进行了重新评判。 评分者 A 是确定性的自动评分器；评分者 B 是十个前沿模型的盲评分片，它们能看到相关状态的捕获 DOM、截图和控制台日志，以及断言文本，但永远不会看到 gate 实现、参考补丁或验证器自身的判定。 在两位评分者均提交判定的 n = 359 子集上，他们有 94.2% 的时间达成一致，Cohen κ = 0.820。 评分者 A 对证据不在盲评包内的 gate 按设计弃权，因此已提交判定的子集才是有信息量的子集。 相对于 A/B 共识标签（n = 338），冻结的验证器达到 κ = 0.766，误通过率为 0.044 [0.025, 0.075]，误失败率为 0.190。 按能力分层，Edit 上的 κ 为 0.862（n = 114），Consistency 上为 0.791（n = 117），Repair 上为 0.657（n = 107）；按家族分层，completion 上为 0.772（n = 240），continuity 上为 0.711（n = 98）。

paragraphs.en: Which side of the ledger each claim rests on. The two error rates act on our numbers differently, and the 19.0 % 19.0\% deserves care rather than reassurance. Provenance answers whether a state was passing before, not whether the later failure is correct. A false pass ( 4.4 % 4.4\% ) would put a run into the completing subset that does not belong there, so it bears on the denominator of every post-completion figure, and that is the tight side. A false fail acts in opposite directions depending on which gate produces it. On a completion gate it withholds completion from a run that deserved it. That removes runs from the completing subset, and since the removed runs need not regress at the rate the remaining ones do, it changes the composition of the conditional sample in a direction we cannot sign: dropping low-regression runs would raise the measured rate and dropping high-regression runs would lower it. We therefore read every post-completion figure as conditional on the verifier’s completion verdict, not as a conservative bound. The strict Task% column of Table 1 ( 1.25 1.25 to 3.50 % 3.50\% ) is a floor against false fails only; the 4.4 % 4.4\% false-pass rate acts on it in the other direction. On a continuity gate it would do real damage: a state that still works, judged failed, is counted as a regression that did not happen, inflating the 28.2 % 28.2\% gap and both provenance-exact channels.
paragraphs.zh: 每项结论究竟落在账目的哪一侧。 这两种错误率对我们数字的作用方向不同，19.0\% 这个数字需要认真对待，而不是令人安心。 来源追溯回答的是一个状态此前是否通过，而不是后来的失败判定是否正确。 假通过（4.4\%）会让一个本不属于完成子集的运行进入该子集，因此它影响所有完成之后数字的分母，而那正是最紧的一侧。 假失败的作用方向取决于产生它的门控。 在完成门控上，它会扣留一个本应完成的运行的完成资格。 这会把运行从完成子集中剔除，而由于被剔除的运行不必以剩余运行相同的回归率发生回归，它以一种我们无法确定符号的方式改变了条件样本的构成：剔除低回归率的运行会抬高测得的比率，剔除高回归率的运行则会拉低它。 因此，我们把每一个完成之后的数字都解读为以验证器的完成判定为条件，而不是作为保守下界。 表 1 的严格 Task% 列（1.25 至 3.50\%）只是针对假失败的下界；4.4\% 的假通过率会从另一个方向作用于它。 在延续性门控上，它会造成真正的损害：一个仍然可用的状态被判为失败，会被计为一次并未发生的回归，从而夸大 28.2\% 的差距以及两个来源精确通道的数值。

sents.zh: 在延续性门控上，它会造成真正的损害：一个仍然可用的状态被判为失败，会被计为一次并未发生的回归，从而夸大 28.2\% 的差距以及两个来源精确通道的数值。

paragraphs.en: Where the false fails actually fall. That distinction is measurable in the audit sample. Of the 63 verifier-FAIL verdicts that reach blind consensus, 12 are false fails, the 19.0 % 19.0\% above, and all twelve sit on completion-family gates : screenshot_files (5, a criterion the judge read as vacuous because none was configured), asset_path_signals (4), dom_assertions (2) and visible_text_signals (1). On the conservative continuity family that carries the regression signal, 0 of 7 consensus FAIL verdicts are false (Wilson-95 [ 0 % , 35.4 % ] [0\%,35.4\%] ). Seven verdicts cannot bound that rate tightly, and we do not claim they do. Gate family and temporal role are also different axes. A dom_assertions check belongs to the completion family while its stage is being cleared and then joins the protected set, so a false fail on it at a later checkpoint would be recorded as a protected-state regression even though this audit files it under a completion-family gate. The unit audited here is the family of a verdict, not the regression event, and it therefore cannot on its own bound the error in the 10.8 % 10.8\% . Sampling recorded regression events and checking the before-and-after evidence for the same assertion is the audit this needs, and the first extension we would run.

paragraphs.en: What carries the class-(a) regressions. The same holds for the events themselves. Every one of the 66 class-(a) regressions on the covered completing subset rests on no_horizontal_overflow (37 events) or console_errors (32), and none rests on a gate of the capture-shaped kind ( required_states , state_artifacts , screenshot_files ). Those two gates are narrow measurements: whether the document scrolls sideways at a fixed viewport, and whether the browser console throws. The same gate implementations produce both verdicts, but the initial baselines are captured in our analysis environment and the final workspaces come from the evaluation cluster, so browser build, dependency versions and capture timing are matched by construction only up to that boundary. Appendix I reports what we can say about the two environments agreeing, on a sample small enough that we read the number as supported rather than established. The capture-shaped failure categories visible in Figure 5 belong to the 43.9 % 43.9\% view over all runs, not to the completing subset the 18.3 % 18.3\% is computed on. In panel (b) the two largest entries mean the final workspace could no longer be loaded or captured at the required state, which is the most severe outcome rather than a measurement artifact, and visual_regression is excluded throughout for the same reason it leaves the conservative family; including it would move the pooled rate by under half a point in either direction.

paragraphs.en: Independent-judge cross-check. As a second, cheaper check we sent 600 cells stratified across lh-score buckets and 14 models to a strong LLM judge with the same evidence bundle and no access to gate internals. Forty-five replies (7.5%) could not be parsed into a verdict; they are excluded rather than folded into the denominator, leaving n = 555 n=555 committed verdicts. On those, agreement is 97.7 % 97.7\% with Cohen κ = 0.827 \kappa=0.827 . The error is one-sided in the reassuring direction: the judge never overturned a gate PASS in any of the 34 cases, and all 13 disagreements are cells the gate failed and the judge would have passed (Figure 11 b). Because the parse failures are not verdicts, they cannot be scored either way, so we report both the 555 555 denominator and the 45 exclusions.
paragraphs.zh: 独立评审员的交叉核对。 作为第二种更经济的核对方式，我们向一个强大的 LLM 评审员发送了 600 个按 lh 分数区间分层、覆盖 14 个模型的单元，并提供相同的证据包，但不允许其接触门控内部信息。 有 45 份回复（7.5%）无法解析出判定结果；我们将这些回复排除在外，而不是计入分母，从而留下 n = 555 n=555 个已提交的判定。 在这些判定上，一致率为 97.7 % 97.7\%，Cohen κ = 0.827 \kappa=0.827。 误差是朝令人安心的方向单侧分布的：在全部 34 个案例中，评审员从未推翻门控的 PASS，而全部 13 处不一致都是门控判为失败而评审员会判为通过的单元（图 11 b）。 由于解析失败并不构成判定结果，无法按任一方向计分，因此我们同时报告 555 555 的分母和 45 个排除项。

paragraphs.en: A measured noise floor. Fifteen pairs of one slot and one model replayed three times at temperature zero give a mean lh_score standard deviation of 0.093, above our pre-registered target of 0.05, while the binary verdict is stable in all fifteen pairs. We therefore attach this floor to every per-cell graded number. Aggregate contrasts are judged by their own paired confidence intervals, not against this per-cell spread, which is a different quantity on a different metric. Because a replay runs the entire solver loop again, the observed σ \sigma in Figure 15 measures end-to-end run variability, and it does not isolate the verifier. The gate predicates are deterministic functions of the captured evidence, but the capture itself drives a browser with asynchronous loading, fonts and a dev server, so a deterministic rule does not by itself make the measurement stable. Replaying the verifier alone against fixed initial, passing and failing artifacts, and reporting the gate-flip rate, is a separate experiment we have not run; it is the most direct remaining check on spurious pass-to-fail transitions, and we do not claim its result in this version of the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 实测的噪声底线。 十五对由一个槽位与一个模型组成的组合在温度为零的设置下重复运行三次，得到 lh_score 的标准差均值为 0.093，高于我们预先注册的 0.05 目标，而二元判定在全部十五对中保持稳定。 因此，我们将该底线附加到每个单元格的每一个评分数字上。 汇总对比由其自身的配对置信区间来评判，而不是参照这种每单元格的离散度，后者是不同度量上的另一个量。 由于重放会再次运行整个求解器循环，图 15 中观测到的 σ \sigma 衡量的是端到端运行的可变性，它并未单独隔离验证器。 门限谓词是所捕获证据的确定性函数，但捕获过程本身驱动的浏览器带有异步加载、字体和开发服务器，因此确定性规则本身并不能保证测量结果的稳定。 仅针对固定的初始、通过和失败工件重放验证器并报告门限翻转率，是我们尚未进行的一项单独实验；它是对虚假的从通过到失败转变最直接的剩余检验，并且在本文的这一版本中我们不声明其结果。

paragraphs.en: Three classes of state. A Change run touches states of three kinds: (a) states already working in the initial repository and never named by the task; (b) states the run itself established by clearing an earlier stage; and (c) the target state of the current stage. Only (c) is covered by the completion family. The paper’s two continuity numbers cover (a) and (b) very differently, and conflating them is the main interpretive hazard in the result.
paragraphs.zh: 三类状态。 一次 Change 运行会涉及三类状态：(a) 初始仓库中已在运行且从未被任务点名的状态；(b) 该运行通过清除较早阶段而自行建立的状态；以及 (c) 当前阶段的目标状态。 只有 (c) 属于完成度系列的覆盖范围。 论文中的两个连续性数字对 (a) 和 (b) 的覆盖方式截然不同，将二者混为一谈是理解该结果时的主要风险。

paragraphs.en: What 28.2% is. The continuity checks – the conservative non-completion family (console errors, forbidden text, horizontal overflow, regression text, state artifacts, visual-anchor similarity) fires on the final workspace. A cell in that family may be breaking a class-(a) state, a class-(b) state, or simply failing a global hygiene check that was never passing in the first place; the emitted artifacts do not record which. The 190 / 674 = 28.2 % 190/674=28.2\% figure is therefore a post-completion verification gap , the rate at which finishing the request fails to imply passing everything else we check, and is reported as such everywhere in the paper. Only 35 of those 190 also record a protected-state regression, so the gap is largely not the replay channel restated. Its Wilson-95 interval is [24.9%, 31.7%] and its task-clustered bootstrap interval [19.2%, 38.3%]; per-model point estimates run from 12.1% to 38.2%, and no model is free of the gap. The broad definition adds visual_regression , which is excluded from the conservative family for exactly this reason: it compares against a reference render without recording whether the differing region belongs to the target or to the incumbent page.

paragraphs.en: What 10.8% is. Class (b) is mechanically identifiable. When stage k k clears, the harness appends its acceptance assertions to a protected set, and every subsequent checkpoint in that run re-verifies the whole protected set before judging the new stage. Because the whole sequence is authored and frozen before any solver runs, a later stage that legitimately replaces earlier wording, ordering or state is authored so that the superseded assertion is not in the protected set: admission requires the reference implementation to pass every protected assertion at every later checkpoint, so a plan in which a later requirement contradicts an earlier one fails admission and never enters the suite. Protected assertions therefore stay in force for the rest of the run by construction, and the check on that condition is the reference replay rather than a promise about the authoring. A protected assertion that passed at stage k k and fails at stage k ′ > k k^{\prime}>k is a pass-to-fail transition on a state the run established itself, recorded at the moment it happens; no post hoc labelling is involved. The solver is told about it explicitly and given a chance to repair it, which is why the event is worth counting on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 10.8% 是什么。 类别 (b) 可以通过机械方式识别。 当阶段 k k 通过（clear）时，测试框架（harness）会将其验收断言追加到一个受保护集合中，此后该运行中的每个后续检查点在判定新阶段之前都会重新验证整个受保护集合。 由于整个序列在任何求解器（solver）运行之前就已经编写并冻结，因此后续阶段若合法地替换了较早的措辞、顺序或状态，其编写方式会确保被取代的断言不在受保护集合中：准入要求参考实现在每个后续检查点都通过所有受保护断言，因此后续需求与较早需求相矛盾的计划将无法通过准入，也就不会进入测试套件。 因此，受保护断言在运行的剩余部分中凭构造方式持续有效，对该条件的检查是参考重放，而非关于编写过程的承诺。 一个在阶段 k k 通过而在阶段 k ′ > k k^{\prime}>k 失败的受保护断言，是该运行自身建立的状态上的通过转为失败的转变，并在发生的那一刻被记录下来；不涉及任何事后标记。 求解器会被明确告知这一情况，并有机会进行修复，这正是该事件值得单独计数的原因。

paragraphs.en: Class (a), measured. The initial repository is capturable, so class (a) does not stay hypothetical. Running the frozen suite on the repository as handed covers 234 slots. Of the completing cells that fail a conservative non-completion check without a recorded protected-state regression and a capturable baseline (126 of the 155), 50 fail a gate the untouched repository passed, class-(a) regressions the harness could not previously certify, and 76 fail a gate that was already failing before the run, i.e. a hygiene property the task never fixed. The other 29 sit on slots whose repository does not render as handed, so they have no baseline. Provenance is therefore resolved for all three classes: across the 586 completing cells with an untouched-repository baseline, the two channels identify 107 provenance-exact regressions, 18.3% rather than the 9.7% the protected set alone reaches; over all completing runs the protected-state rate is unchanged at 73 / 674 = 10.8 % 73/674=10.8\% .

paragraphs.en: Coverage of the class-(a) baseline. A slot contributes a baseline only if the repository as handed renders offline under the frozen toolchain: 234 of the 320 Change slots qualify, and 128 of those are served by the project’s own dev server rather than as a built static tree. The 86 excluded slots skew towards stacks with a build step (58% versus 41% among included slots), though no-build static sites are the second-largest excluded group, so the exclusion is not specific to bundlers. Two checks bound the effect. The protected-state rate on the covered completing subset is 9.7 % 9.7\% against 10.8 % 10.8\% on all 674 completing cells, so no shift of that size is detectable between them; and visual_regression is excluded from the class-(a) definition for the same reason it is excluded from the conservative family, which moves the pooled rate by 0.2 0.2 points.

paragraphs.en: Robustness of the estimate. The rate is 73 / 674 = 10.8 % 73/674=10.8\% [ 8.7 % 8.7\% , 13.4 % 13.4\% ] among completing runs and 823 / 6,305 = 13.1 % 823/6{,}305=13.1\% [ 12.2 % 12.2\% , 13.9 % 13.9\% ] among non-completing runs; the intervals overlap, so no difference of that size is detectable between them, which is a bound on the association, not evidence that none exists. Per-model point estimates span 3.6 % 3.6\% (MiniMax-M3) to 20.7 % 20.7\% (GPT-5.5) over 32 to 80 completing cells each, and the ordering does not track overall WCS: the two strongest models by WCS sit at 6.2 % 6.2\% and 20.7 % 20.7\% respectively. Regression propensity is thus a partly independent axis of model behaviour, which is the case for measuring it. Two caveats hold for every cross-model comparison of this rate. Each model is conditioned on the tasks it completed, and those sets differ; and a model that clears more stages is verified at more checkpoints, so it has more opportunity for a protected assertion to be observed flipping. We therefore read the per-model rates as descriptive, and compare models only like for like on their commonly completed tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 估计量的稳健性。 在完成的运行中该比例为 73 / 674 = 10.8 % 73/674=10.8\% [ 8.7 % 8.7\% , 13.4 % 13.4\% ]，在未完成的运行中为 823 / 6,305 = 13.1 % 823/6{,}305=13.1\% [ 12.2 % 12.2\% , 13.9 % 13.9\% ]；两个区间相互重叠，因此无法在两者之间检测到该量级的差异，这是对关联程度的界限，而非不存在关联的证据。 各模型的点估计在 3.6 % 3.6\%（MiniMax-M3）到 20.7 % 20.7\%（GPT-5.5）之间，每个模型各有 32 至 80 个完成的单元，且该排序与整体 WCS 并不对应：按 WCS 计最强的两个模型分别处于 6.2 % 6.2\% 和 20.7 % 20.7\%。 因此，回归倾向是模型行为的一个部分独立的维度，这正是测量它的意义所在。 对该比例的每一次跨模型比较都存在两个需要注意的事项。 每个模型都以它所完成的任务为条件，而这些任务集合各不相同；并且一个通过更多阶段的模型会在更多检查点接受验证，因此它有更多机会观察到受保护断言被翻转。 因此，我们将各模型的比例视为描述性数据，并且只在共同完成的任务上以同类对同类的方式比较模型。

sents.en: Two caveats hold for every cross-model comparison of this rate.
sents.zh: 对该比例的每一次跨模型比较都存在两个需要注意的事项。

sents.en: Each model is conditioned on the tasks it completed, and those sets differ; and a model that clears more stages is verified at more checkpoints, so it has more opportunity for a protected assertion to be observed flipping.
sents.zh: 每个模型都以它所完成的任务为条件，而这些任务集合各不相同；并且一个通过更多阶段的模型会在更多检查点接受验证，因此它有更多机会观察到受保护断言被翻转。

sents.en: We therefore read the per-model rates as descriptive, and compare models only like for like on their commonly completed tasks.
sents.zh: 因此，我们将各模型的比例视为描述性数据，并且只在共同完成的任务上以同类对同类的方式比较模型。

paragraphs.en: Trajectory against endpoint. Replay fires whenever a cleared assertion flips, and 38 of the 73 runs that record one finish with every conservative check clean, so the trajectory rate is roughly twice the end-state rate. The untouched-repository channel is a final-state measure by construction, which is why the two are reported at both observation points rather than merged.
paragraphs.zh: 轨迹对照终点。 当已通过的断言发生翻转时就会触发重放，73 次运行中有 38 次记录了一次断言且最终所有保守检查全部通过，因此轨迹比率大约是终态比率的两倍。 未改动仓库这一通道从构造上讲就是终态度量，这也是为什么两者在两个观测点上分别报告而非合并。

paragraphs.en: The protected-state endpoint is not yet resolved by these arms. Applying the same protected-state test to every single-variable arm we ran gives no significant movement at the available sample sizes. Table 10 lists the counts: no arm shifts more than a handful of cells, and no paired statistic clears its own standard error. The gate-level effects reported in Section 5 are real; the claim that they operate through the regression channel is not supported by these data, and we do not make it. Arms powered for this endpoint are the natural next experiment.
paragraphs.zh: 这些实验组尚未解决受保护状态端点的问题。 将相同的受保护状态检验应用于我们运行的每个单变量实验组，在现有样本量下均未发现显著变化。 表 10 列出了计数：没有任何实验组的移动超过少量单元格，且没有任何配对统计量超过其自身的标准误。 第 5 节报告的门级效应是真实的；但这些数据并不支持它们通过回归渠道发挥作用的说法，我们也不做此断言。 为该端点提供统计功效的实验组是自然的下一步实验。

paragraphs.en: The task counts in the paper refer to different sets and are not interchangeable. The validated authoring pool holds 479 tasks, each with a passing reference and a failing authored control. The locked evaluation suite is the 400 of those used for every number here, 320 Change and 80 Build. Of the 320 Change tasks, all 320 rebuild from the frozen package in the analysis environment and 234 of those also serve a capturable initial baseline, which is the coverage of the class-(a) channel; 128 of the served ones run the project’s own dev server rather than a built static tree. A further 16 Change slots carry no capability label in the frozen manifest and enter overall columns only. Task-clustered bootstraps resample tasks with all of their cells, so repeated runs of one task are not treated as independent. Tasks derived from the same upstream repository could still correlate beyond that, and we do not currently report a repository-level clustering; the released manifest carries the source path for every task, so that grouping can be recomputed from the release without rerunning anything.
paragraphs.zh: 论文中的任务计数对应不同的集合，不可互换使用。 经过验证的创作任务池包含 479 个任务，每个任务都有一个通过的参考实现和一个失败的作者控制版本。 锁定的评测套件是其中用于本文所有数字的 400 个任务，即 320 个 Change 和 80 个 Build。 在 320 个 Change 任务中，全部 320 个都能在分析环境中从冻结包重建，其中 234 个还能提供可捕获的初始基线，这就是类-(a) 通道的覆盖范围；在被提供的任务中，有 128 个运行项目自带的开发服务器而非构建后的静态目录。 另有 16 个 Change 槽位在冻结清单中没有能力标签，仅计入总览列。 按任务聚类的自助法重采样会将任务及其所有单元格一起重采样，因此同一任务的多次运行不会被当作相互独立。 派生自同一上游仓库的任务仍可能存在超出该范围的相关性，而我们目前未报告仓库级聚类；发布的清单包含每个任务的源路径，因此无需重新运行任何内容，即可从发布物中重新计算该分组。

paragraphs.en: Run configuration. Solver and simulated user are separate models. The simulated user is held fixed across the sweep so that persona behaviour is not a free variable between models, and the persona names in Appendix C label prompt variants rather than model configurations. Every cell records, in its released row, the solver model identifier, the leg, the number of turns and tokens actually used, the edits applied and rejected, the per-stage trace, and which gates failed; the route, viewport and action prefix each gate was evaluated at is fixed per state by the released state_plan.json of that task. Infrastructure failures (install failure, timeout, provider error) are written as infra_failed and the cell is re-run rather than scored, so they do not enter any denominator; a gate that a task does not configure is not counted in that task’s gate total, which is why gate totals vary by task and why Gate% is a rate rather than a count. The five screenshot_files false fails in the audit sample are exactly the case where a judge read an unconfigured criterion as vacuously failing, and they are counted against the verifier in Appendix D rather than excused.
paragraphs.zh: 运行配置。 求解器与模拟用户是分开的模型。 模拟用户在整个扫描过程中保持固定，从而使人设行为不会成为模型之间的自由变量，且附录 C 中的人设名称标注的是提示词变体，而非模型配置。 每个单元格在其发布的行中记录求解器模型标识符、执行侧、实际使用的轮数与 token 数、已应用与被拒绝的编辑、各阶段追踪记录以及哪些门控失败；每个门控被评估时所用的路由、视口和动作前缀，由该任务发布的 state_plan.json 按状态固定。 基础设施故障（安装失败、超时、提供商错误）会被记录为 infra_failed，且该单元格会被重新运行而非计分，因此它们不计入任何分母；某任务未配置的门控不计入该任务的门控总数，这就是门控总数因任务而异、以及 Gate% 是一个比率而非计数的原因。 审计样本中五处 screenshot_files 的误判失败，正是评审者将未配置的判据读作空泛失败的情况，这些在附录 D 中被计入验证器的失误，而非被谅解。

paragraphs.en: Models, denominators and statistical conventions. The 13 models are Claude Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.5, Gemini 3.5 Flash, DeepSeek V4 Pro and Flash, GLM-5.2-FP8, Hunyuan 3 Preview, Kimi K2.7 Code and K3, MiniMax M3, Qwen 3.6 and Qwen 3.7 Max. The four without a screenshot leg send no image on any screenshot cell, so they are evaluated text-only rather than simulated with empty image turns, and a cell scored against a superseded specification is rerun rather than carried forward. Denominators differ by question: the post-completion gap uses all 6,979 Change cells, the long-horizon analysis the 1,758 Build cells stratified by stage count, the Build against Change comparison 7,142 cells from the nine dual-modal systems, and the modality experiment 3,558 within-model, within-task pairs from those same nine. The post-completion gap and both regression channels resample tasks with all of their cells, because several runs of the same task differ only in model or modality. Paired modality differences use Wilcoxon signed-rank tests; paired arms are judged by their own confidence intervals. Long-horizon results are bucketed by stage count, Kruskal–Wallis diagnostics are exploratory, and Benjamini–Hochberg correction is applied throughout to the framework and the facet families.
paragraphs.zh: 模型、分母与统计惯例。 这 13 个模型是 Claude Opus 4.8 和 Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.5、Gemini 3.5 Flash、DeepSeek V4 Pro 和 Flash、GLM-5.2-FP8、Hunyuan 3 Preview、Kimi K2.7 Code 和 K3、MiniMax M3、Qwen 3.6 和 Qwen 3.7 Max。 四个没有截图分支的系统在任何截图单元格上都不发送图像，因此它们仅以纯文本方式评估，而不是用空的图像回合来模拟；凡是依据已被取代的规范打分的单元格都会重跑，而不是沿用旧结果。 分母因问题而异：完成后的差距使用全部 6,979 个 Change 单元格，长程分析使用按阶段数量分层的 1,758 个 Build 单元格，Build 与 Change 的对比使用来自九个双模态系统的 7,142 个单元格，模态实验则使用来自同样这九个系统的 3,558 个模型内、任务内配对。 完成后的差距和两条回归通道都以任务连同其全部单元格为单位重采样，因为同一任务的多次运行往往仅在模型或模态上不同。 配对的模态差异使用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验；配对分组则依据其自身的置信区间来判断。 长程结果按阶段数量分桶，Kruskal–Wallis 诊断仅作探索性用途，并且在框架与维度族上全程应用 Benjamini–Hochberg 校正。

paragraphs.en: The failures are not patch machinery. The 8,737 live cells divide exactly into the 198 whole-task passes of Table 1 and 8,539 failures. Among the failures, 8,396 (98.3%) land at least one edit; in 7,002 (82.0%) the cumulative count of applied edits exceeds rejected edits and the run still does not pass; 1,394 (16.3%) edit the workspace but have rejected edits at least as numerous as applied ones; and only 143 (1.7%) land no edit at all, so a no-edit explanation covers under two per cent of them. Landing one edit does not exclude a later patch failing on format or scope, so these counts bound the tooling account rather than eliminating it.
paragraphs.zh: 这些失败并非补丁机制所致。 8,737 个活跃单元恰好划分为表 1 中 198 个整任务通过案例和 8,539 个失败案例。 在这些失败中，8,396 个（98.3%）至少落地了一次编辑；7,002 个（82.0%）已应用编辑的累计数量超过被拒绝的编辑数量，但运行仍未通过；1,394 个（16.3%）对工作区进行了编辑，但被拒绝的编辑数量不少于已应用的数量；只有 143 个（1.7%）完全没有任何编辑落地，因此「无编辑」的解释最多只能覆盖其中不到百分之二的案例。 落地一次编辑并不意味着后续补丁不会因格式或范围问题而失败，因此这些计数只是为工具性解释划定了界限，而非将其彻底排除。

paragraphs.en: Ranking coherence across capability slices. The mean Spearman correlation between a per-capability WCS ranking and the overall WCS ranking is 0.885: Edit ρ = 0.934 \rho=0.934 , Consistency ρ = 0.934 \rho=0.934 , Build ρ = 0.852 \rho=0.852 , Repair ρ = 0.819 \rho=0.819 . Agreement on the overall order is thus strong on every slice, and Build is not the weakest of them; what distinguishes Build is that it permutes the top of the ranking rather than the whole of it (Figure 10 ).

paragraphs.en: The static arm is not a comparable half. Classifying the suite by whether a task’s frozen specification declares interaction assertions splits it into 379 interactive slots and 21 static ones. The pooled within-model gap is − 9.18 -9.18 points of 100 × 100\times WCS, static minus interactive (Figure 8 a), but the split is confounded with regime: 20 of the 21 static slots are Build slots, so the comparison is mostly Build against Change. Within regime the gap collapses to − 0.90 -0.90 points on Build and − 0.91 -0.91 on Change, and it is no longer negative for every model. The slot-level split therefore does not carry an interaction result on its own. The confound-free view is the paired one of Section 5 : on interactive cells whose static DOM requirement already passes, the interaction assertions still fail 29.5% of the time. What a static DOM assertion accepts and what an action sequence accepts are not the same bar.
paragraphs.zh: 静态臂并非可比的对照半边。 按任务的冻结规格是否声明交互断言来划分套件，可将其分为 379 个交互槽位和 21 个静态槽位。 汇总后的模型内差距为 − 9.18 -9.18 分（100 × 100\times WCS 制下，静态减去交互）（图 8a），但这一划分与任务机制混杂：21 个静态槽位中有 20 个是 Build 槽位，因此该比较主要是 Build 与 Change 之间的对比。 在同一机制内，差距缩小为 Build 上 − 0.90 -0.90 分、Change 上 − 0.91 -0.91 分，并且不再对每个模型都为负。 因此，槽位级别的划分本身并不承载交互方面的结论。 无混杂的视角是第 5 节的配对视角：在静态 DOM 要求已经通过的交互单元上，交互断言仍有 29.5% 的情况失败。 静态 DOM 断言所接受的标准，与动作序列所接受的标准，并不是同一条线。

paragraphs.en: Failure radius. Within the 432 complete-but-not-cleared cells of the broad visual-inclusive definition, a cell fails 1.37 distinct non-completion signals on average: 31.9% fail at least two and 4.4% at least three. The count is over individual signals, not over the three gate families of Appendix B . These are broad sensitivity diagnostics rather than confirmed regression radii, since the broad family does not separate target from prior state (Figure 8 b).
paragraphs.zh: 失败半径。 在宽泛含视觉定义的432个完成但未清除的单元中，平均每个单元触发1.37个不同的未完成信号：31.9%的单元至少触发两个信号，4.4%的单元至少触发三个信号。 该计数是按单个信号统计的，而非按附录B中的三类门槛家族统计。 这些是宽泛的敏感性诊断，而非已确认的回归半径，因为该宽泛家族并未将目标状态与先前状态区分开（图8b）。

paragraphs.en: Model separation and the twin set. The graded WCS has model-level dynamic range on Build: an exploratory Kruskal–Wallis diagnostic gives H = 118.6 H=118.6 and p = 1.2 × 10 − 19 p=1.2\times 10^{-19} ; because task cells repeat across models and modalities we read it as a separation check rather than population-level inference. On the greenfield twins of Section 5 , stage counts match by construction (twin mean 5.67 against source mean 5.81, Δ = − 0.14 \Delta=-0.14 ), and eighteen of the twenty-one sit on no-build static or vanilla-node sites. Restricting to the 70 pairs whose stage counts are identical leaves Δ ​ Gate% \Delta\text{Gate\%} at − 7.67 -7.67 , so the regime gap is not an artifact of plan length. The paired comparison is therefore read within that regime, where it holds the end state, the acceptance gates and the stage count fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 模型分离与孪生集合。 分级 WCS 在 Build 上具有模型级的动态范围：探索性的 Kruskal–Wallis 诊断给出 H = 118.6 H=118.6 和 p = 1.2 × 10 − 19 p=1.2\times 10^{-19}；由于任务单元格在不同模型与模态间重复出现，我们将其视为分离性检验而非总体层面的推断。 在第 5 节的全新孪生体中，阶段数在构造上是匹配的（孪生体均值 5.67 对比源均值 5.81，Δ = − 0.14 \Delta=-0.14），且二十一个中的十八个位于无构建静态站点或纯节点站点上。 仅限于阶段数完全相同的 70 对时，Δ Gate% \Delta\text{Gate\%} 仍为 − 7.67 -7.67，因此该机制间的差距并非计划长度造成的假象。 因此，配对比较是在该机制内进行解读的，其中终态、验收门控与阶段数均保持固定。

paragraphs.en: The component mean, and what the grid does not control. The scaffold arm verifies once at the end, so WCS is undefined for it and the contrasts use the component mean : the unweighted mean of the eight per-cell component scores the verifier emits (change completion, the six continuity facets, and browser execution), which needs no intermediate checkpoint and is defined in both arms. The comparison is limited to two backbones and four shared scaffolds, and we did not equalise time or token budgets across scaffolds, so any budget difference sits inside the measured scaffold effect rather than being controlled out of it.
paragraphs.zh: 组件均值，以及网格不控制的部分。 脚手架分支（scaffold arm）只在最后验证一次，因此它没有 WCS 定义，其对比采用组件均值：即验证器给出的八个逐单元组件得分（变更完成度、六个连续性维度以及浏览器执行）的未加权平均值，它不需要中间检查点，并且在两个分支中都有定义。 该比较仅限于两个骨干（backbone）和四个共享脚手架，并且我们没有在各脚手架之间均衡时间或令牌预算，因此任何预算差异都包含在所测得的脚手架效应之内，而不是被控制排除在外。

paragraphs.en: Scaffold versus backbone, in full. On the matched 4 × 2 4\times 2 grid the scaffold spread under a fixed backbone is 8.06 8.06 pt on Sonnet-4.6 and 10.52 10.52 pt on GPT-5.5, against 5.08 5.08 pt for the backbone swap under a fixed scaffold; the unit is the per-cell component mean and the swap is paired by task. The paired backbone swap favours GPT-5.5 for every scaffold, from + 0.60 +0.60 to + 8.27 +8.27 pt. Scaffold rank order is largely preserved across backbones (Spearman ρ = 0.80 \rho=0.80 ), so the two factors are close to additive. Widening to all seven Sonnet-4.6 scaffolds gives a mean pairwise component-mean gap of 5.68 5.68 pt, matching the backbone effect across a full model change.
paragraphs.zh: 脚手架与底座模型的完整对比。 在匹配的 4 × 2 4\times 2 网格上，固定底座模型时脚手架带来的差异在 Sonnet-4.6 上为 8.06 8.06 pt，在 GPT-5.5 上为 10.52 10.52 pt，而固定脚手架时更换底座模型的差异为 5.08 5.08 pt；单位为每格组件均值，且更换按任务配对。 配对的底座模型更换在所有脚手架下都偏向 GPT-5.5，幅度从 + 0.60 +0.60 到 + 8.27 +8.27 pt。 脚手架的排名顺序在不同底座模型间基本保持不变（Spearman ρ = 0.80 \rho=0.80 ），因此两个因素接近于可加。 扩展到全部七个 Sonnet-4.6 脚手架后，两两组件均值差的平均值为 5.68 5.68 pt，与完整更换模型时的底座模型效应相当。

paragraphs.en: Change capability scores. Across all 13 models, pooled Change WCS is 0.342 for Edit (2,310 cells), 0.450 for Repair (1,653), and 0.305 for Consistency (2,665); a further 351 cells sit on 16 slots with no capability label in the frozen manifest, excluded from this breakdown. Consistency remains 0.035 WCS below Edit ( se = 0.007 \mathrm{se}=0.007 , t = − 5.07 t=-5.07 , p = 4.0 × 10 − 7 p=4.0\times 10^{-7} ) after controlling for five task-size proxies and model fixed effects in a single linear model on the 6,628 labelled cells; the category block itself is significant (partial F = 182.48 F=182.48 on ( 2 , 6608 ) (2,6608) degrees of freedom, p = 7.3 × 10 − 78 p=7.3\times 10^{-78} ). Every size-proxy Spearman correlation with WCS has magnitude below 0.055, so category differences are not explained by specification size alone. The size proxies are counts of required states, hidden states, required content items, suggested files, and stages; no literal diff-line count exists in the frozen artifacts, which is why proxies are used.
paragraphs.zh: 变更能力分数。 在全部 13 个模型中，汇总的变更 WCS 为：Edit 0.342（2,310 个单元格）、Repair 0.450（1,653 个）、Consistency 0.305（2,665 个）；另有 351 个单元格位于冻结清单中没有能力标签的 16 个槽位上，未纳入此细分统计。 在对 6,628 个有标签单元格构建的单一线性模型中，控制五个任务规模代理变量和模型固定效应后，Consistency 仍比 Edit 低 0.035 WCS（ se = 0.007 \mathrm{se}=0.007 ， t = − 5.07 t=-5.07 ， p = 4.0 × 10 − 7 p=4.0\times 10^{-7} ）；类别区块本身显著（偏 F = 182.48 F=182.48 ，自由度为 ( 2 , 6608 ) (2,6608) ， p = 7.3 × 10 − 78 p=7.3\times 10^{-78} ）。 各规模代理变量与 WCS 的 Spearman 相关性绝对值均低于 0.055，因此类别间的差异无法仅用规格规模来解释。 这些规模代理变量分别是所需状态数、隐藏状态数、所需内容项数、建议文件数和阶段数；冻结产物中不存在字面上的 diff 行数，因此使用代理变量。

sents.en: Consistency remains 0.035 WCS below Edit ( se = 0.007 \mathrm{se}=0.007 , t = − 5.07 t=-5.07 , p = 4.0 × 10 − 7 p=4.0\times 10^{-7} ) after controlling for five task-size proxies and model fixed effects in a single linear model on the 6,628 labelled cells; the category block itself is significant (partial F = 182.48 F=182.48 on ( 2 , 6608 ) (2,6608) degrees of freedom, p = 7.3 × 10 − 78 p=7.3\times 10^{-78} ).
sents.zh: 在对 6,628 个有标签单元格构建的单一线性模型中，控制五个任务规模代理变量和模型固定效应后，Consistency 仍比 Edit 低 0.035 WCS（ se = 0.007 \mathrm{se}=0.007 ， t = − 5.07 t=-5.07 ， p = 4.0 × 10 − 7 p=4.0\times 10^{-7} ）；类别区块本身显著（偏 F = 182.48 F=182.48 ，自由度为 ( 2 , 6608 ) (2,6608) ， p = 7.3 × 10 − 78 p=7.3\times 10^{-78} ）。

sents.en: Every size-proxy Spearman correlation with WCS has magnitude below 0.055, so category differences are not explained by specification size alone.
sents.zh: 各规模代理变量与 WCS 的 Spearman 相关性绝对值均低于 0.055，因此类别间的差异无法仅用规格规模来解释。

sents.en: The size proxies are counts of required states, hidden states, required content items, suggested files, and stages; no literal diff-line count exists in the frozen artifacts, which is why proxies are used.
sents.zh: 这些规模代理变量分别是所需状态数、隐藏状态数、所需内容项数、建议文件数和阶段数；冻结产物中不存在字面上的 diff 行数，因此使用代理变量。

paragraphs.en: Framework, facet, and size controls. Three further breakdowns support the category result in the main text. Per-framework WCS (Figure 12 ) separates harder and easier stacks after Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment; at the exploratory cell level the spread across framework labels is large ( H = 1552.5 H=1552.5 on 21 degrees of freedom, p < 10 − 300 p<10^{-300} ), with SPA and bundler-heavy stacks at the hard end and static or lighter systems at the easy end, though cells are not independent within a task so we read this as a description of the observed panel rather than population inference. Per-model facet ranking (Figure 13 ) shows regression-continuity is the easiest facet for all 13 models and construction the hardest for 12 of them, so the facet ordering is a property of the tasks rather than of any one model. The size control (Figure 14 ) repeats the category comparison on the smallest quartile of tasks and recovers the same ordering.
paragraphs.zh: 框架、维度与规模对照。 三个进一步的细分结果支持正文中的类别结论。 按框架划分的 WCS（图 12）在 Benjamini–Hochberg 校正后区分了较难与较容易的技术栈；在探索性的单元格层面，不同框架标签之间的差异很大（自由度为 21 时 H=1552.5，p<10^{−300}），其中 SPA 和重度依赖 bundler 的技术栈处于较难一端，静态或较轻量的系统处于较容易一端，但由于同一任务内的单元格并非相互独立，我们将其视为对所观察面板的描述，而非对总体的推断。 按模型的维度排名（图 13）显示，回归连续性是全部 13 个模型中最容易的维度，而构建则是其中 12 个模型中最难的维度，因此维度排序是任务本身的属性，而非任何一个模型的属性。 规模对照（图 14）在规模最小四分位的任务上重复了类别比较，并得到相同的排序。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon boundary. The negative relation between turns and progress appears only on long tasks. Within five- and six-stage buckets, the correlation between turns and stages cleared is positive (0.32 and 0.24 respectively). It becomes negative for every bucket from 7 through 14 stages: − 0.93 -0.93 , − 0.80 -0.80 , − 0.94 -0.94 , − 0.90 -0.90 , − 0.97 -0.97 , − 0.96 -0.96 , − 0.82 -0.82 , and − 0.66 -0.66 . This is why the main text reports a within-length median rather than the pooled correlation. Failed units can consume the whole budget, so the buckets diagnose cap persistence rather than the causal effect of adding turns.
paragraphs.zh: 长时程边界。 轮数与进展之间的负相关仅在长任务上出现。 在五阶段和六阶段的分桶内，轮数与已清除阶段数之间的相关性为正（分别为 0.32 和 0.24）。 而对于 7 至 14 阶段的每个分桶，该相关性均为负：−0.93、−0.80、−0.94、−0.90、−0.97、−0.96、−0.82 和 −0.66。 这正是正文报告按任务长度分组的均值中位数（within-length median）而非合并相关性的原因。 失败的单元可能耗尽全部预算，因此这些分桶诊断的是上限持续性（cap persistence），而非增加轮数的因果效应。

paragraphs.en: Feedback-modality validity. We call a model dual-modal only when more than half of its screenshot-feedback cells actually send at least one image, which guards against the failure mode of a text-only endpoint silently accepting and discarding the image turn. Nine of the thirteen models clear this bar, with image-carrying fractions from 0.807 to 0.912: Opus-4.8, Sonnet-4.6, Gemini-3.5, GPT-5.5, Hunyuan-3, Kimi-K2.7, Kimi-K3, MiniMax-M3, and Qwen3.6. Four are excluded because their screenshot leg sends images on zero cells (GLM-5.2-FP8, DeepSeek-V4-Flash, DeepSeek-V4-Pro, and Qwen3.7-Max), and are reported as not applicable rather than simulated with empty image turns. The paired estimate therefore rests on nine models and 3,558 within-model, within-task pairs; the count exceeds the 400-task suite because each task contributes one pair per qualifying model. The contrast is between assignment to the screenshot policy and assignment to the text-only policy: image-carrying fractions run from 0.807 to 0.912 even among qualifying models, so a pair differs in the policy applied rather than in whether the solver certainly saw an image on every turn. Restricting to pairs that did carry an image would condition on run progress and is not an unbiased comparison. On those pairs the mean change in WCS with screenshot feedback is − 0.0007 -0.0007 , bootstrap interval [ − 0.0064 -0.0064 , 0.0050 0.0050 ], Wilcoxon p = 0.952 p=0.952 . The completion proxy moves + 0.0037 +0.0037 ( p = 0.334 p=0.334 ) and the broad visual-inclusive continuity proxy − 0.0124 -0.0124 ([ − 0.0216 -0.0216 , − 0.0031 -0.0031 ], p = 0.009 p=0.009 ). Screenshots help one facet, experience, by + 0.0144 +0.0144 over n = 728 n=728 pairs ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ), too narrow a base to carry the aggregate, and not enough to offset the loss on broad continuity.
paragraphs.zh: 反馈模态的有效性。 只有当某个模型的截图反馈单元格中实际发送至少一张图像的比例超过一半时，我们才称其为双模态模型，这可以防止纯文本端点静默接受并丢弃图像回合这一失效模式。 十三个模型中有九个达到这一门槛，其携带图像的比例从 0.807 到 0.912：Opus-4.8、Sonnet-4.6、Gemini-3.5、GPT-5.5、Hunyuan-3、Kimi-K2.7、Kimi-K3、MiniMax-M3 和 Qwen3.6。 四个模型被排除，因为它们的截图端在所有单元格上均未发送图像（GLM-5.2-FP8、DeepSeek-V4-Flash、DeepSeek-V4-Pro 和 Qwen3.7-Max），我们将它们报告为不适用，而不是用空的图像回合进行模拟。 因此，配对估计基于九个模型的 3,558 个模型内、任务内配对；该数量超过 400 个任务的套件，因为每个任务会为每个符合条件的模型贡献一个配对。 对比在于被分配到截图策略与被分配到纯文本策略之间：即使在符合条件的模型中，携带图像的比例也在 0.807 到 0.912 之间，因此一对的差异在于所应用的策略，而不在于求解器是否确定在每一回合都看到了图像。 仅限于确实携带图像的配对将以运行进度为条件，这不是无偏比较。 在这些配对上，截图反馈下 WCS 的平均变化为 − 0.0007 -0.0007，自助法区间 [ − 0.0064 -0.0064，0.0050 0.0050 ]，Wilcoxon p = 0.952 p=0.952。 完成度代理指标上升 + 0.0037 +0.0037（p = 0.334 p=0.334），而宽泛的包含视觉的连续性代理指标下降 − 0.0124 -0.0124（[ − 0.0216 -0.0216，− 0.0031 -0.0031 ]，p = 0.009 p=0.009）。 截图在经验这一维度上有 + 0.0144 +0.0144 的帮助（基于 n = 728 n=728 个配对，p = 0.001 p=0.001），但这一基础过窄，不足以支撑总体结果，也不足以抵消宽泛连续性上的损失。

paragraphs.en: Robustness and validity ablations. Table 13 collects the single-variable checks that could otherwise explain these results: edit format, vision on either side of the loop, simulated-user wording, and rerun variability. No arm produces a net strict-pass gain; the only arm whose net strict-pass count changes at all is solver vision, at − 0.06 -0.06 percentage points, and the sim-user vision arm is the only one where a single cell of thirteen moves in either direction; none clears the | t | > 2 |t|>2 threshold on Δ \Delta Gate%. No arm in this table moves the graded metric outside the rerun noise floor; only the two prompt-scale interventions of Section 5 do, and even there the effect is established at the gate level only; Appendix E reports the protected-state endpoint for every arm in this table and finds no significant movement in any of them. Two of these rows exist specifically to rebut the objection that the simulated user is doing the solver’s diagnostic work: stripping the persona down to raw failed-gate names and error strings moves Δ \Delta Gate% by − 3.38 -3.38 pt ( t = − 0.94 t=-0.94 ), and giving the simulated user a screenshot on every turn moves it by + 2.43 +2.43 pt ( t = + 0.70 t=+0.70 ). Neither is distinguishable from zero, so the score is not an artifact of persona phrasing. For the two arms that do move the gate rate, the movement is confined to gate quality: truncating the solver’s history shifts stage completion by only − 1.78 -1.78 pt against its − 9.40 -9.40 pt on Δ \Delta Gate%, and leaves turn count flat.
paragraphs.zh: 鲁棒性与有效性消融实验。 表 13 汇总了那些可能解释上述结果的单变量检查：编辑格式、循环任一侧的视觉输入、模拟用户的措辞，以及重跑波动性。 没有任何一个实验组产生净严格通过增益；唯一净严格通过数量发生变化的实验组是求解器视觉输入，变化为 −0.06 个百分点，而模拟用户视觉输入实验组是唯一一个在十三个单元格中有单个单元格发生双向移动的实验组；没有任何一组在 ΔGate% 上超过 |t| > 2 的阈值。 表中没有任何实验组使被评分的指标超出重跑噪声底限；只有第 5 节中两个提示词规模的干预做到了这一点，即便如此，其效应也仅在门控层面得到确立；附录 E 报告了表中每个实验组的受保护状态终点，发现它们都没有显著变动。 其中两行专门用于反驳“模拟用户在替求解器做诊断工作”这一质疑：将人设精简为仅提供原始失败门控名称和错误字符串，会使 ΔGate% 变动 −3.38 个百分点（t = −0.94），而让模拟用户在每一轮都获得屏幕截图，则使其变动 +2.43 个百分点（t = +0.70）。 两者均与零无异，因此该得分并非人设措辞造成的伪影。 对于确实使门控通过率发生移动的两个实验组，其移动仅限于门控质量：截断求解器的历史记录仅使阶段完成率变动 −1.78 个百分点，而其在 ΔGate% 上变动为 −9.40 个百分点，且轮次数量保持不变。
