paragraphs.en: The two verdicts come apart, and the gap is not small. A target-only metric is satisfied the moment the requested DOM appears. On our suite that moment is routinely reached while the surrounding product is already broken: 28.2% of the Change runs that clear every requested-work gate still fail a conservative non-completion check, and among interactive runs whose target DOM passes, 29.5% still fail an interaction check on the very element they were asked to produce. The first number says a correct target does not imply an intact site; the second says it does not even imply a working feature. Both are invisible to an endpoint DOM assertion. That is why the unit we score is the change together with the website it lands in.

paragraphs.en: Provenance is what makes a regression claim defensible. Calling an outcome a regression requires knowing the state was good before, and a benchmark that only inspects the final workspace cannot know that. Our two channels each carry that evidence by construction: one replays a state the run itself cleared, the other checks a gate the untouched repository already satisfied. The untouched-repository channel also shows that two of its gates report one event: all 1,364 runs that leave a route blank also fail the capture check on that route. Their union covers 18.3% of the covered subset while they overlap on 2.7%, so they are complementary views that partly coincide, not one effect counted twice. We do not read the small overlap as independence: under independence the expected overlap is about 6.4 runs against an observed 16. The replay channel then splits in a way no endpoint-only harness can see: of the 10.8% of completing runs that break a protected state, a little over half finish with every conservative check clean, the rest do not. Because the endpoint is a run-level verdict, not a per-assertion repair record, that first group is invisible to a final-state measure – the run ends looking clean and the damage happened anyway.
paragraphs.zh: 溯源是让回归声明站得住脚的关键。 把一个结果称为回归需要知道此前的状态是好的，而一个只检查最终工作区的基准无法知道这一点。 我们的两个通道各自在构造上就携带这种证据：一个重放由运行本身清理过的状态，另一个检查未被改动过的仓库已经满足的关卡。 未改动仓库的通道还显示其两个关卡报告了同一事件：所有 1,364 次将路由留空的运行也未能通过该路由的捕获检查。 两者的并集覆盖了被覆盖子集的 18.3%，而它们的重叠部分为 2.7%，因此它们是部分重合的互补视角，而非同一效应被计算了两次。 我们并不把这个小的重叠解读为独立性：在独立假设下，期望重叠约为 6.4 次运行，而实际观测到的是 16 次。 重放通道随后以一种只看端点的测试框架无法察觉的方式进行了划分：在 10.8% 破坏受保护状态的完成运行中，略过半数的运行在结束时所有保守检查均无异常，其余则不然。 由于端点是运行级别的判定，而非逐断言的修复记录，第一组对最终状态的度量是不可见的——运行结束时看起来干净无恙，而损害实际上已经发生。

sents.zh: 溯源是让回归声明站得住脚的关键。

paragraphs.en: Long trajectories do not quietly fix themselves. Within every fixed stage-count bucket on Build the correlation between turns spent and stages cleared is negative, median − 0.91 -0.91 : units that clear finish quickly, while a failed one consumes its full budget. A unit stops when it clears or when the budget runs out, so the correlation partly reflects that rule; what it shows is that turn count on its own does not separate a recovering trajectory from a stuck one, which is a reason not to read persistence as progress. The failures are also not an artifact of patch machinery. Of the 8,539 failing cells, 98.3% land at least one edit and only 1.7% land none, so under two per cent of failures can be explained by an agent that never managed to write to the workspace.
paragraphs.zh: 长轨迹并不会悄无声息地自我修复。 在 Build 上每一个固定阶段数的分桶内，所花费的轮数与已完成的阶段数之间的相关性为负，中位数为 −0.91：能完成的单元总是很快就结束，而失败的单元则会耗尽全部预算。 单元要么在完成时停止，要么在预算耗尽时停止，因此这种相关性在一定程度上反映了该规则；它所表明的是，轮数本身并不能将一条正在恢复的轨迹与一条陷入停滞的轨迹区分开来，这也是不应把持续尝试解读为进展的一个理由。 这些失败也不是补丁机制造成的人为现象。 在 8,539 个失败的单元中，98.3% 至少落地了一次编辑，只有 1.7% 一次编辑都没有落地，因此只有不到百分之二的失败可以归因于智能体根本无法写入工作区。

paragraphs.en: More perception is not the missing ingredient. On matched pairs differing in whether the solver gets the screenshot feedback policy, the graded score moves by − 0.0007 -0.0007 , indistinguishable from zero, and broad visual-inclusive continuity moves against the screenshot arm. Assignment is not the same as exposure: even among qualifying models, between 0.807 and 0.912 of screenshot cells actually carry an image. The one facet that improves, experience, is too narrow to carry the aggregate. We read this as a statement about the bottleneck rather than about vision: on these tasks the most likely constraint is knowing which prior behaviour is protected, which a screenshot of the current page does not supply. No experiment here isolates that hypothesis.
paragraphs.zh: 更多的感知并不是缺失的关键要素。 在仅以求解器是否获得截图反馈策略而区分的配对中，评分分数变动为 −0.0007，与零无异，而包含视觉的宽泛连续性反而向截图组相反的方向移动。 分配并不等同于暴露：即使在符合条件的模型中，0.807 到 0.912 之间的截图单元格实际上才携带图像。 唯一改善的方面——经验——过于狭窄，无法支撑整体。 我们将此解读为关于瓶颈而非视觉的论断：在这些任务上，最可能的约束是知道哪些先前的行为受到保护，而当前页面的截图并不能提供这一点。 这里的任何实验都没有隔离该假设。

sents.zh: 更多的感知并不是缺失的关键要素。

paragraphs.en: The harness is part of the measurement. In the full-spec scaffold arm, the scaffold spread under a fixed backbone is larger than the effect of swapping the backbone under a fixed scaffold, yet scaffold rank order is largely preserved when the backbone changes. The two factors are close to additive: swapping the backbone helps every scaffold, by between 0.60 0.60 and 8.27 8.27 points. The practical consequence is that a frontend agent score is not interpretable without the scaffold that produced it, and that the two can be improved separately.
paragraphs.zh: 测试框架本身也是度量的一部分。 在全规格脚手架实验分支中，固定骨干下更换脚手架带来的差异大于固定脚手架下更换骨干带来的差异，但当骨干变化时，脚手架的排名次序基本保持不变。 这两个因素接近于可加性：更换骨干能让每个脚手架都获益，提升幅度在 0.60 0.60 到 8.27 8.27 分之间。 实际结论是：前端智能体分数若脱离产生它的脚手架便无法解读，而且这两者可以分开改进。

sents.en: The harness is part of the measurement.
sents.zh: 测试框架本身也是度量的一部分。

sents.en: In the full-spec scaffold arm, the scaffold spread under a fixed backbone is larger than the effect of swapping the backbone under a fixed scaffold, yet scaffold rank order is largely preserved when the backbone changes.

paragraphs.en: The simulated user is an evaluation interface, deliberately so. One capability-conditioned persona per task reveals requirements authored in advance and gives grounded feedback, while the frozen verifier alone decides acceptance. That separation is what makes runs comparable across thirteen models: the conversation can vary without moving the bar. Multi-role interaction, adversarial users and negotiated requirements are natural extensions, and because acceptance is independent of the dialogue they can be added on the same frozen states and gates without reauthoring the suite.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟用户是一个评测接口，而且是刻意如此设计的。 每个任务对应一个由能力条件化的人物设定，既能揭示事先编写的需求，又能给出有依据的反馈，而验收仅由固定的验证器决定。 正是这种分离使得十三个模型的运行结果可以相互比较：对话可以变化，而标准保持不动。 多角色交互、对抗性用户和协商式需求都是自然的扩展；由于验收独立于对话本身，这些扩展可以在同一套固定状态和门控上直接加入，而无需重写整个测试集。

sents.zh: 模拟用户是一个评测接口，而且是刻意如此设计的。

paragraphs.en: Three boundaries define where the claims of Section 5 apply.
paragraphs.zh: 三个边界界定了第 5 节中的论断的适用范围。

paragraphs.en: The twin result is stated for its regime. The greenfield-twin finding, that from-scratch construction scores below the matched in-place change on all five legs, is established on 21 length-matched Change tasks whose twins are mostly static or vanilla-node sites, because our authoring chain yields a blank baseline only for those stacks. We state it for that regime, not for arbitrary stacks.
paragraphs.zh: 孪生结果是针对其适用范围陈述的。 全新孪生的发现——即从零构建在全部五个维度上都低于匹配的就地修改——是基于 21 个长度匹配的 Change 任务确立的，这些任务的孪生大多是静态或原生节点站点，因为我们的编写链路仅在这些技术栈上才能产生空白基线。 我们针对该范围陈述这一结论，而非针对任意技术栈。

sents.en: The twin result is stated for its regime.
sents.zh: 孪生结果是针对其适用范围陈述的。

sents.en: The greenfield-twin finding, that from-scratch construction scores below the matched in-place change on all five legs, is established on 21 length-matched Change tasks whose twins are mostly static or vanilla-node sites, because our authoring chain yields a blank baseline only for those stacks.
sents.zh: 全新孪生的发现——即从零构建在全部五个维度上都低于匹配的就地修改——是基于 21 个长度匹配的 Change 任务确立的，这些任务的孪生大多是静态或原生节点站点，因为我们的编写链路仅在这些技术栈上才能产生空白基线。

sents.en: We state it for that regime, not for arbitrary stacks.
sents.zh: 我们针对该范围陈述这一结论，而非针对任意技术栈。

paragraphs.en: The turn budget is endogenous. Failed units consume the stage cap while cleared units stop early, so turn count is an outcome of the trajectory as much as an input. We report persistence to the cap as an observation about how these trajectories end, not a causal claim about what extra turns buy.
paragraphs.zh: 回合预算是内生的。 未通过的单元会耗尽阶段上限，而通过的单元会提前停止，因此回合数既是轨迹的结果，也是输入。 我们报告触及上限的持续情况，是作为对这些轨迹如何结束的一种观察，而不是关于额外回合能带来什么收益的因果性结论。

sents.en: The turn budget is endogenous.
sents.zh: 回合预算是内生的。

sents.en: Failed units consume the stage cap while cleared units stop early, so turn count is an outcome of the trajectory as much as an input.
sents.zh: 未通过的单元会耗尽阶段上限，而通过的单元会提前停止，因此回合数既是轨迹的结果，也是输入。

sents.en: We report persistence to the cap as an observation about how these trajectories end, not a causal claim about what extra turns buy.

paragraphs.en: Coverage is uneven and cells are clustered. Provider availability leaves coverage uneven, and several cells share a task. We state every denominator, use matched pairs where one exists, report a task-clustered interval beside each cell-level one, and read the pooled table as observed coverage, the paired contrasts carrying the claims. The same applies to the capability-against-regression comparison of Section 5 , which thirteen models bound loosely but cannot rule out.
paragraphs.zh: 覆盖不均衡，且单元格呈聚集分布。 服务商的可用性导致覆盖不均衡，且多个单元格共享同一任务。 我们报告每个分母，在存在配对时使用匹配对，在每个单元格层面的区间旁报告任务聚类的区间，并将汇总表解读为观测到的覆盖情况，而由配对对比承载各项结论。 这同样适用于第 5 节中能力对回归的比较，十三个模型只能宽松地约束该比较，但无法将其排除。

sents.en: Coverage is uneven and cells are clustered.
sents.zh: 覆盖不均衡，且单元格呈聚集分布。

sents.en: Provider availability leaves coverage uneven, and several cells share a task.
sents.zh: 服务商的可用性导致覆盖不均衡，且多个单元格共享同一任务。

paragraphs.en: Two scope notes close the picture. Visual anchors are deterministic checks on authored properties, not a measure of unrestricted aesthetic quality. And the interventions of Section 5 are prompt-scale probes aimed at the graded gate metric; testing whether a prompt can move the rarer protected-state endpoint needs a separately powered arm, as the arm-by-arm figures in Appendix E show.

paragraphs.en: Gate judgement carries across environments. The class-(a) baseline (Appendix E ) is captured in the analysis environment rather than on the evaluation cluster, so we calibrated the two against a known answer: a reference implementation must pass every gate by admission. Re-capturing six reference workspaces locally reproduces that verdict on the five that serve offline: four pass all nineteen gates and one misses only visual_regression , the gate excluded throughout for its uncontrolled scroll offset. The sixth does not start a server in the analysis harness and yields no verdict either way. Every served recapture agrees with the cluster on every nonvisual gate. Five workspaces are a small sample, so this supports rather than establishes cross-environment equivalence for the eighteen gates the class-(a) statistic uses; replaying the initial and the final workspace of the same run side by side in one environment is the check that would settle it.
paragraphs.zh: 门槛判定可跨环境迁移。 (a) 类基线（附录 E）是在分析环境中而非评估集群上采集的，因此我们用一个已知答案对两者进行了校准：一个参考实现按准入标准必须通过所有门槛。 在本地重新采集六个参考工作区，可复现其中五个离线服务工作区的判定结果：四个通过全部十九项门槛，一个仅未通过 visual_regression——该门槛因其不可控的滚动偏移而全程被排除。 第六个工作区在分析测试框架中不启动服务器，因此无论怎样都得不到判定。 每个已提供服务的重新采集工作区在所有非视觉门槛上都与集群结果一致。 五个工作区只是小样本，因此这支持而非确立 (a) 类统计所用的十八项门槛的跨环境等价性；在同一环境中并排重放同一次运行的初始和最终工作区，才是能定论这一问题的检验。

paragraphs.en: Ten of the baselines were captured later than the rest, on a rebuilt analysis machine, which lets us separate two questions the first calibration conflates. Repeating the known-answer test there gives the same result: of the reference workspaces that serve, one passes seventeen of nineteen gates and three pass eighteen, and the only gate all four miss is visual_regression . The environment therefore still judges a correct implementation correctly. Recapturing the untouched repository is a different matter: over thirteen slots and 247 gate verdicts, a recapture agrees with the frozen baseline on 85% of them, and the disagreements concentrate in console_errors , no_horizontal_overflow and visual_anchor_similarity , in both directions. A reference implementation sits far from those thresholds and a partly broken repository sits on them, so the pristine side of the comparison is the browser-version-sensitive one. We therefore read a single slot’s baseline as an environment-conditional reading rather than an absolute one; the ten late captures move the union count by one event, from 106 to 107.
paragraphs.zh: 十个基线是在其余基线之后于重建的分析机器上采集的，这让我们能够区分首次校准所混淆的两个问题。 在该机器上重复已知答案测试得到相同结果：四个可用的参考工作区中，一个通过十九道关卡中的十七道，三个通过十八道，而四者唯一都未通过的关卡是 visual_regression 。 因此，该环境仍然能对正确的实现作出正确判定。 重新采集未改动的仓库则是另一回事：在十三个槽位和 247 项关卡判定中，重新采集结果与冻结基线有 85% 一致，分歧集中在 console_errors 、 no_horizontal_overflow 和 visual_anchor_similarity 上，且两个方向都有。 参考实现远低于那些阈值，而部分损坏的仓库恰在其附近，因此比较中的纯净一侧才是对浏览器版本敏感的那一侧。 因此，我们将单一槽位的基线解读为环境条件下的读数而非绝对读数；十个后期采集使并集计数增加一个事件，从 106 变为 107。

paragraphs.en: Cases (1) to (4) walk one live cell from each of the four ProductWebBench capabilities, in the order the paper introduces them, and show what the frozen contract catches on the corresponding real frontend. Cases (5) to (7) then take the three contributions of Section 1 one at a time and show each of them firing on a single task. Browser crops are actual screenshots retained under siflow/output_b/cells/ ; final checks and stage outcomes come from submission_results.json , trace.json , and result_b.json . All seven are chosen for the visual strength of the reference UI and for a clean contract exercise, not as prevalence estimates.
paragraphs.zh: 案例（1）至（4）按照论文介绍的顺序，从 ProductWebBench 的四项能力中各选取一个活跃单元进行推演，并展示冻结契约在对应真实前端上捕获到了什么。 案例（5）至（7）随后逐一采用第 1 节的三项贡献，展示它们各自在单个任务上触发的情况。 浏览器截图是保存在 siflow/output_b/cells/ 下的实际截图；最终检查和阶段结果来自 submission_results.json、trace.json 和 result_b.json。 之所以选择这七个案例，是因为参考 UI 具有视觉代表性且能干净地演练契约，而非作为流行度估计。

paragraphs.en: Table 14 maps the cases to the capability axes and what the verifier grades. Case (1) exercises a project-path selector that rewires the visible set, Case (2) tests preserved content on a rich album page, Case (3) checks a bound scroll-driven interaction survives a scene-composition edit, and Case (4) demands every unit clear within budget on a passing final replay. The last three show the contract rejecting an authored near-miss, protected-state replay firing on a run whose endpoint looks clean, and the untouched-repository channel catching a property the run never asserted.
paragraphs.zh: 表 14 将各用例映射到能力轴以及校验器所评定的内容。 用例 (1) 测试一个会重连可见集合的项目路径选择器，用例 (2) 在内容丰富的相册页面上测试被保留的内容，用例 (3) 检查一个绑定的滚动驱动交互是否能在场景组合编辑后依然存活，用例 (4) 则要求在最终重放通过时每个单元都在预算内完成。 最后三个用例展示了契约拒绝一个人为制造的近似命中，受保护状态重放在一个端点看似干净的运行中触发，以及未触碰仓库的通道捕获一个该运行从未断言过的属性。

paragraphs.en: Slot 252 is an Edit task on Marlow Ferris , a Vite + React + TypeScript portfolio. A simulated PM asks, over four staged requirements, for the project path selector to be clarified (s1), carried consistently onto the portfolio view (s2), genuinely wired up on desktop rather than merely looking selected (s3), and kept inside a narrow viewport (s4); two reworks, a late wording and ordering change and a mobile QA bug, then verify everything again already cleared. Hunyuan-3-Preview drove the screenshot leg for 39 turns, asked 11 clarifying questions, and applied 15 edits.
paragraphs.zh: 插槽 252 是一个关于 Marlow Ferris 的编辑任务，这是一个 Vite + React + TypeScript 作品集项目。 一位模拟产品经理通过四个分阶段的需求，要求澄清项目路径选择器（s1），并将其一致地带入作品集视图（s2），在桌面上真正实现接线而不是仅仅看起来被选中（s3），并保持在一个狭窄的视口内（s4）；随后两次返工、一次晚期的措辞与顺序变更以及一个移动端 QA 缺陷，验证了一切——而这些问题此前已被清除。 Hunyuan-3-Preview 在截图环节驱动了 39 轮，提出了 11 个澄清问题，并应用了 15 次编辑。

paragraphs.en: Figure 17 shows stage s3, the stage that makes the capability nontrivial. Its checkpoint is a single interaction_assertions clause: the state desktop_portfolio_filtered must be reached from desktop_portfolio by a real click ( require_interaction: true ), it must differ from the state it came from ( changed_from ), and the resulting DOM must contain the exact string Showing 2 of 5 . A chip that merely receives an active outline satisfies none of the three. In the replay, clicking Launch switches the active chip, drops the readout from Showing 5 of 5 ⋅ \cdot All Work to Showing 2 of 5 ⋅ \cdot Launch , and swaps the selected-project panel from Harborline Redesign to Signal Contact Kit : the count, the label and the content all move together.
paragraphs.zh: 图 17 展示了阶段 s3，也就是让该能力变得非平凡的那个阶段。 它的检查点是一个单独的 interaction_assertions 子句：状态 desktop_portfolio_filtered 必须通过真实点击从状态 desktop_portfolio 达到（ require_interaction: true ），它必须与来源状态不同（ changed_from ），并且 resulting DOM 必须包含精确字符串 Showing 2 of 5 。 一个仅仅接收到激活轮廓的芯片无法满足这三条中的任何一条。 在重放中，点击 Launch 会切换激活芯片，把读数从 Showing 5 of 5 ⋅ \cdot All Work 变为 Showing 2 of 5 ⋅ \cdot Launch ，并把所选项目面板从 Harborline Redesign 切换为 Signal Contact Kit ：计数、标签和内容一起变动。

sents.en: In the replay, clicking Launch switches the active chip, drops the readout from Showing 5 of 5 ⋅ \cdot All Work to Showing 2 of 5 ⋅ \cdot Launch , and swaps the selected-project panel from Harborline Redesign to Signal Contact Kit : the count, the label and the content all move together.
sents.zh: 在重放中，点击 Launch 会切换激活芯片，把读数从 Showing 5 of 5 ⋅ \cdot All Work 变为 Showing 2 of 5 ⋅ \cdot Launch ，并把所选项目面板从 Harborline Redesign 切换为 Signal Contact Kit ：计数、标签和内容一起变动。

paragraphs.en: The cell clears s2, s3 and s4 and passes all 19 final gates with zero protected-state regressions, but it never clears s1, and neither rework is cleared; its long-horizon score is therefore 0.875 0.875 , not 1 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体清除了 s2、s3 和 s4，并在全部 19 道最终门控上零受保护状态回归地通过，但它始终未能清除 s1，且两次返工也未被清除；因此其长程得分为 0.875 0.875 ，而非 1 1 。

paragraphs.en: What this establishes. Edit-family tasks in ProductWebBench do not grade the requested DOM addition on its own; they grade whether the addition is live . The frozen contract for s3 names the predecessor state, demands that the successor be reached by an interaction, and pins the exact N of M string that interaction must produce, so a purely cosmetic chip row fails the stage while still rendering perfectly. Because the two reworks verify every earlier stage again, the same contract also asks whether a late wording change and a mobile fix can be absorbed while everything earlier keeps passing. Here the earlier states do hold (the run records no protected-state regression), but neither rework clears, which is why it stops at 0.875 0.875 despite a clean final gate sheet. That gap is the common shape of a strong ProductWebBench run: the visible artefact looks finished, and the staged contract still records what was left behind.
paragraphs.zh: 这确立了什么。 ProductWebBench 中的编辑类任务并不单独评判所要求的 DOM 添加本身，而是评判该添加是否已实际生效。 s3 的冻结契约指明了前驱状态，要求必须通过一次交互到达后继状态，并固定了该交互必须产生的 N of M 字符串的确切内容，因此即使页面渲染完美无缺，仅在外观上添加的芯片行也无法通过该阶段。 由于两次返工都会重新验证所有更早的阶段，同一契约还会检验：在所有更早阶段持续通过的前提下，后期的措辞修改和移动端修复能否被顺利吸收。 在这里，更早的状态确实保持住了（运行记录中没有受保护状态的回退），但两次返工都未能通过，这就是为什么尽管最终的门控检查表很干净，分数仍停留在 0.875 0.875。 这一差距正是 ProductWebBench 强大运行的常见形态：可见的成果看起来已经完成，而分阶段的契约仍然记录着被遗留下来的东西。

paragraphs.en: Slot 020 asks Claude Opus 4.8 (VLM) to extend a record-label site while retaining the frozen Neon Dreams album page. The reference layout is a cyberpunk-cityscape artwork hero, a strictly ordered ten-track list, an artist byline, and a now spinning rail at the bottom. The requested change is to append a next drop teaser into the now spinning rail without altering any incumbent element. In the solver’s replay every one of the four protected regions survives the diff: the artwork tile, all ten track lines in their original order, the by Echo Lume byline, and the release meta block still read identically to the reference; the now spinning rail gains a valid Wanderer’s Rest tile in the new slot.
paragraphs.zh: Slot 020 要求 Claude Opus 4.8（VLM）扩展一个唱片公司网站，同时保留冻结的 Neon Dreams 专辑页面。 参考版式是：赛博朋克城市景观艺术图作为主视觉（hero）、一个严格排序的十首曲目列表、一行艺术家署名，以及底部的「正在播放」（now spinning）栏。 所请求的变更是向「正在播放」栏追加一个下一次发行（next drop）预告，而不改动任何现有元素。 在求解器的重放中，全部四个受保护区域都在差异比对中得以保留：艺术图块、按原始顺序排列的全部十条曲目行、by Echo Lume 署名以及发行元信息块与参考版本读起来完全一致；「正在播放」栏在新槽位中新增了一个有效的 Wanderer's Rest 图块。

paragraphs.en: Figure 18 places the two renders side by side.
paragraphs.zh: 图 18 将两个渲染结果并排放置。

paragraphs.en: What this establishes. Consistency-family tasks in ProductWebBench do not grade on the requested feature alone; they grade on whether the preexisting site (routes, layouts, protected copy, artwork tiles, ordered list content) survives every diff. In slot 020 the frozen contract explicitly names the ten track lines (in order), the album masthead, the artwork tile, and the release meta as preserved-content anchors; the verifier crops all four regions on the solver’s final replay and compares them to the frozen reference. It also fires the now spinning rail’s next-drop cue again to confirm that the newly added tile is a valid drop and not a placeholder. This case is instructive precisely because a naive completion grader would give the same solver full credit on a much narrower requested change (adding a next-drop rail); only the Consistency contract catches the much larger question of whether the ten-track list, artwork, and release meta all made it through unchanged. Here the answer is yes end-to-end, and the retained interaction on the now spinning rail confirms it.
paragraphs.zh: 这确立了什么。 ProductWebBench 中的一致性类任务并不只依据所请求的功能评分；它们依据的是既有站点（路由、布局、受保护的文案、艺术图磁贴、有序列表内容）是否在每个 diff 中都得以保留来评分。 在槽位 020 中，冻结的契约明确指定了十条曲目行（按顺序）、专辑页眉、艺术图磁贴以及发行元信息作为保留内容锚点；验证器在智能体的最终重放中裁剪这四个区域，并将其与冻结的参考进行对比。 它还会再次触发当前正在旋转的轮播的下一次投放提示，以确认新增的磁贴是一个有效的投放项而不是占位符。 这个案例之所以具有启发性，正是因为一个朴素的补全评分器会在一个窄得多的所请求变更（添加一个下一次投放轮播）上给智能体满分；只有一致性契约才能捕捉到那个大得多的问题：十条曲目列表、艺术图和发行元信息是否都原封不动地保留了下来。 在这里，答案是端到端的确认为是，而当前正在旋转的轮播上保留的交互也证实了这一点。

paragraphs.en: Slot 178 asks Kimi-K3 (LLM) to repair a Codrops cinematic scene director on a GSAP + OGL Astro site. The reference desktop_home carries a twelve-frame cylindrical viewport driven by scroll, a scene director control panel (four scene chips: All chapters, Opening, Ascent, Skyline) and a Now cueing status line. Editing the panel to add a second demo variant is a scene-composition change: it must render a new scroll-linked scene without breaking any previously cleared chapter cue or the runtime metadata (frames, chapters, runtime, motion). In the solver’s replay the new demo-2 route renders a black DISCOVER — The Future of Architecture scene, the ten chapter chips (DISCOVER, CYBERPUNK, PENETRATION, ELEVATION, INTERLOCK, VISION, ARCHITECTURE, FUTURE, SUMMIT, WELCOME) still cue the correct scroll progress, and the scene-director’s field-notes rail stays bound to the active scene.
paragraphs.zh: 槽位 178 要求 Kimi-K3（LLM）修复一个基于 GSAP + OGL 的 Astro 站点上的 Codrops 电影化场景导演。 参考桌面首页（desktop_home）包含一个由滚动驱动的十二帧圆柱形视口、一个场景导演控制面板（四个场景芯片：All chapters、Opening、Ascent、Skyline）以及一条 Now 提示状态行。 编辑面板以添加第二个演示变体属于场景构图变更：它必须渲染一个新的滚动联动场景，且不能破坏任何已通过验证的章节提示或运行时元数据（帧数、章节数、运行时长、动效）。 在求解器的回放中，新的 demo-2 路由渲染出一个黑色的 DISCOVER — The Future of Architecture 场景，十个章节芯片（DISCOVER、CYBERPUNK、PENETRATION、ELEVATION、INTERLOCK、VISION、ARCHITECTURE、FUTURE、SUMMIT、WELCOME）仍能提示正确的滚动进度，且场景导演的现场笔记栏仍与当前激活的场景保持绑定。

paragraphs.en: Figure 19 shows the reference scene and the replay.
paragraphs.zh: 图 19 展示了参考场景与回放。

paragraphs.en: What this establishes. Repair-family tasks in ProductWebBench check for a much stricter property than a green diff: after the edit lands, every previously cleared interaction on the affected and neighbouring routes must still fire correctly at final replay. Slot 178’s frozen contract binds the scene director to a twelve-frame OGL cylinder with two demo variants, a ten-chip chapter navigator, and four runtime-metadata fields. The verifier runs the scroll interaction again on desktop_demo2 after the edit, reads the SCENE 01/10 DISCOVER state again at the first stop, cycles through the remaining chapter chips, and confirms that (a) the cylinder still transitions across all twelve frames without missing a chapter cue, (b) the runtime line still reads 500svh , and (c) neither Demo 1 nor the tutorial route regresses. Nothing about the diff itself would tell us whether the scroll-linked cues survived; only cumulative replay does. The result is meaningful because scene-composition edits (adding the demo-2 variant, retitling chapter cues, threading a new motion mode) routinely break the scroll bindings in similar Codrops-based sites; here the solver preserves them.
paragraphs.zh: 这确立了什么。 ProductWebBench 中的修复类任务检查的是比绿色 diff 严格得多的性质：编辑落地后，受影响路由及相邻路由上每一个此前已通过的交互，都必须在最终重放时仍能正确触发。 槽位 178 的冻结契约将场景导演绑定为带两个演示变体的十二帧 OGL 圆柱体、一个十芯片的章节导航器，以及四个运行时元数据字段。 验证器在编辑后于 desktop_demo2 上再次运行滚动交互，在第一个停靠点重新读取 SCENE 01/10 DISCOVER 状态，循环切换其余章节芯片，并确认：(a) 圆柱体仍能在全部十二帧间过渡且不遗漏任何章节提示，(b) 运行时行仍显示 500svh，(c) Demo 1 与教程路由均未回退。 diff 本身丝毫不能告诉我们这些滚动关联的提示是否得以保留；只有累计重放才能证明。 这个结果是有意义的，因为在类似的基于 Codrops 的站点中，场景构成类编辑（新增 demo-2 变体、重命名章节提示、引入新的运动模式）经常会破坏滚动绑定；而此处的求解器成功保留了它们。

paragraphs.en: Slot 211 asks Kimi-K3 (LLM) to build a full Operations Pulse admin board on top of the Dashmin shell over nine ordered stage/rework units: shell scaffolding, sidebar navigation, the pulse-board header, the four KPI tiles ( Open tickets , Response SLA , Active users , Records synced ), the Support-versus-Traffic toggle, the two chart cards ( Worldwide sales , Sales & Revenue ), the Recent Sales table, the notifications rail, and a mobile-containment pass at 390 pixels. Nine of nine stage/rework units clear inside their 12-turn budgets, and the final replay passes the nineteen-gate suite. The reference and solver captures at desktop_notifications_open both show the identical four KPI tiles, the Support/Traffic toggle in the same state, the two chart cards with the same series, and the notifications rail open at the same items (Figure 20 ).
paragraphs.zh: 槽位 211 要求 Kimi-K3（LLM）在 Dashmin 外壳之上，经过九个有序的阶段/返工单元构建一个完整的 Operations Pulse 管理面板：外壳脚手架、侧边栏导航、pulse-board 头部、四个 KPI 卡片（Open tickets、Response SLA、Active users、Records synced）、Support-versus-Traffic 切换开关、两个图表卡片（Worldwide sales、Sales & Revenue）、Recent Sales 表格、通知栏，以及在 390 像素下的移动端适配检查。 九个阶段/返工单元全部在其 12 轮预算内通过，最终回放通过了十九项检查的测试套件。 在 desktop_notifications_open 处的参考截图与求解器截图均显示完全相同的四个 KPI 卡片、处于相同状态的 Support/Traffic 切换开关、具有相同数据系列的两个图表卡片，以及打开在相同条目处的通知栏（图 20）。

sents.en: Slot 211 asks Kimi-K3 (LLM) to build a full Operations Pulse admin board on top of the Dashmin shell over nine ordered stage/rework units: shell scaffolding, sidebar navigation, the pulse-board header, the four KPI tiles ( Open tickets , Response SLA , Active users , Records synced ), the Support-versus-Traffic toggle, the two chart cards ( Worldwide sales , Sales & Revenue ), the Recent Sales table, the notifications rail, and a mobile-containment pass at 390 pixels.

sents.en: Nine of nine stage/rework units clear inside their 12-turn budgets, and the final replay passes the nineteen-gate suite.
sents.zh: 九个阶段/返工单元全部在其 12 轮预算内通过，最终回放通过了十九项检查的测试套件。

sents.en: The reference and solver captures at desktop_notifications_open both show the identical four KPI tiles, the Support/Traffic toggle in the same state, the two chart cards with the same series, and the notifications rail open at the same items (Figure 20 ).
sents.zh: 在 desktop_notifications_open 处的参考截图与求解器截图均显示完全相同的四个 KPI 卡片、处于相同状态的 Support/Traffic 切换开关、具有相同数据系列的两个图表卡片，以及打开在相同条目处的通知栏（图 20）。

paragraphs.en: What this establishes. Build-family tasks are the strictest signal ProductWebBench produces: a run is only marked passed when every stage/rework unit clears within its 12-turn budget and the final replay passes all nineteen gates on the retained state. In slot 211 both hold: each KPI tile renders with the frozen value, the Support/Traffic toggle switches its metric label without breaking the underlying series, the two chart cards read the same USA/UK/AU distribution as the reference, and the notifications rail opens on demand. The trajectory itself is also clean: no stage was capped, no rework requested by the PM unit went unresolved, and the mobile-containment gate at a 390-pixel viewport passes on the last checkpoint. A positive Build signal therefore asserts not just a passing final render, but a passing final render on top of nine successful budgeted milestones.
paragraphs.zh: 这确立了什么。 构建族类任务是 ProductWebBench 产生的最严格的信号：只有在每个阶段/返工单元都在其 12 轮预算内通过，且最终重放在保留状态上通过全部十九道关卡时，一次运行才会被标记为通过。 在槽位 211 中两者都成立：每个 KPI 磁贴都以冻结值渲染，Support/Traffic 切换开关在不破坏底层序列的情况下切换其指标标签，两个图表卡片读取的 USA/UK/AU 分布与参考一致，并且通知栏可按需打开。 轨迹本身也很干净：没有任何阶段被截断，PM 单元提出的返工都没有未解决，并且 390 像素视口下的移动端收容关卡在最后一个检查点通过。 因此，一个正面的构建信号不仅断言最终渲染通过，还断言在九个成功完成的受预算里程碑之上最终渲染通过。

paragraphs.en: Taken together , the four capability cases rest on different evidence: Edit on a shared component and its cross-route reuse, Consistency on preserved copy, artwork and ordered lists, Repair on cumulative replay of cleared interactions after a heavy edit, and Build on every unit clearing inside its turn budget. A single pass therefore carries different weight by capability, which is why ProductWebBench keeps three records: the final artifact, what it preserves, and which stages cleared inside the budget. The three cases that follow take the contributions one at a time on the same evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，四个能力案例依赖不同的证据：Edit 依赖共享组件及其跨路由复用，Consistency 依赖被保留的文案、美术素材和有序列表，Repair 依赖在大幅编辑之后对被清除交互的累积回放，Build 依赖每个单元在其轮次预算内通过。 因此，一次通过在不同能力上具有不同的分量，这正是 ProductWebBench 保留三项记录的原因：最终产物、它保留了什么，以及哪些阶段在预算内通过。 接下来的三个案例在相同证据上逐一考察各项贡献。

sents.zh: 综合来看，四个能力案例依赖不同的证据：Edit 依赖共享组件及其跨路由复用，Consistency 依赖被保留的文案、美术素材和有序列表，Repair 依赖在大幅编辑之后对被清除交互的累积回放，Build 依赖每个单元在其轮次预算内通过。

paragraphs.en: Slot 306 is a Marlowe & Field storefront whose Consistency task asks for a workshop-promise card beside the product grid. Admission runs twice on this package before any solver sees it. The reference patch is applied to the initial repository and must clear every gate; an authored plausible-wrong solution is applied to the same repository and must fail at least one. Figure 21 shows both at desktop_catalog_layout . The control is not a strawman: it keeps the four product cards, the prices, the wishlist affordances and the heading, and a reader skimming the page would take it for a working implementation. What it drops is the promise card’s ground and the basket badge’s tint, exactly the class of change the task is about, and the frozen gates reject it.
paragraphs.zh: 槽位 306 是一个 Marlowe & Field 店面，其一致性（Consistency）任务要求在商品网格旁放置一张工作坊承诺卡片。 该包在任何求解器看到之前会进行两次准入处理。 参考补丁被应用到初始仓库，必须通过所有关卡；一个人为编写的貌似合理但错误的解法被应用到同一仓库，必须至少在一个关卡上失败。 图 21 在 desktop_catalog_layout 处同时展示了这两者。 这个对照并非稻草人：它保留了四张商品卡片、价格、愿望清单交互元素和标题，粗略浏览页面的读者会把它当作一个可用的实现。 它删去的是承诺卡片的底色和购物篮徽章的色调，而这正是任务所针对的那类改动，因此冻结的关卡将其拒绝。

paragraphs.en: What this establishes. Because the reference passed and the control failed on this package, a later model failure here cannot be explained by an impossible requirement or by a gate that waves a plausible regression through. This held for all 479 references and all 479 controls, which is what makes the numbers in Section 4 readable as model behaviour.
paragraphs.zh: 这确立了什么。 由于参照项在此包上通过而对照项失败，此处的后续模型失败就不能归因于不可能满足的要求，也不能归因于放行了貌似合理的回归的门槛。 这在全部 479 个参照项和全部 479 个对照项上都成立，正是这一点使第 4 节中的数字可以被解读为模型行为。

paragraphs.en: Slot 114 is the Marrowbrook Family Dental practice site, and its Edit task runs ten ordered units across the home, treatments and pricing routes. Claude Sonnet 4.6 clears all ten of them over 29 turns and 37 applied edits, and the final workspace passes eighteen of nineteen gates. Figure 22 shows why an endpoint-only harness would record this as a near-perfect run: the delivered home page is the reference page. Protected-state replay tells a different story about how it got there. Eleven times during the trajectory, an assertion that had already cleared at an earlier stage failed at a later checkpoint, and each of those flips was repaired before the run ended, which is why the endpoint gate sheet shows no trace of a single one of them.
paragraphs.zh: 槽位 114 是 Marrowbrook 家庭牙科诊所的站点，其编辑任务在首页、治疗和定价三条路由上运行十个有序单元。 Claude Sonnet 4.6 在 29 轮对话和 37 次应用编辑中完成了全部十个单元，最终工作区通过了十九道关卡中的十八道。 图 22 展示了为什么仅基于端点的测试框架会把这次运行记录为近乎完美：交付的首页正是参考页面。 受保护状态重放则讲述了一个不同的故事，说明它是如何达到这一结果的。 在整个轨迹过程中有十一次，某个在较早阶段已经通过的断言在后续检查点上失败了，而每一次这种翻转都在运行结束前被修复，这就是端点关卡表上看不到任何一丝痕迹的原因。

sents.zh: 受保护状态重放则讲述了一个不同的故事，说明它是如何达到这一结果的。

paragraphs.en: What this establishes. This cell sits in the 38 of 674 completing runs that regress a protected state and still finish with every conservative check clean, the row of Table 9 only cumulative verification can populate. The clean endpoint and the eleven flips are both recorded truthfully and they answer different questions, but a benchmark that keeps only the endpoint cannot tell a steady run from a thrashing one that happened to land.
paragraphs.zh: 这确立了什么。 该单元格位于「完成运行中回归受保护状态、但最终仍通过所有保守检查」的 674 例中的 38 例，是表 9 中只有累积验证才能填充的那一行。 干净的终点和十一次翻转都被如实记录下来，它们回答的是不同的问题，但一个只保留终点的基准测试无法区分一次稳定的运行与一次恰好落在正确位置上的反复震荡的运行。

paragraphs.en: Slot 157 is the WeatherGPT prompt explorer, and its Repair task asks for the category filter to apply correctly to the prompt cards. Figure 23 shows the reference and the MiniMax-M3 replay at desktop_explorer_travel : the Travel chip is active in both, the same three travel prompts are listed, and the readout reads Showing 3 ⋅ \cdot Travel in both. All seven stage units cleared and every completion gate passes, so the requested repair landed. Protected-state replay records nothing, because no stage in this run ever asserted the browser console. The untouched-repository channel does: the repository as handed to the solver serves this route with a clean console, and the delivered workspace no longer does once the repair has landed.
paragraphs.zh: 槽位 157 是 WeatherGPT 提示词探索器，其修复任务要求分类筛选器能正确作用于提示词卡片。 图 23 展示了参考结果与 MiniMax-M3 在 desktop_explorer_travel 的重放：两者中 Travel 标签均处于激活状态，列出的都是同样三条旅行提示词，且两者的读数均显示 Showing 3 ⋅ \cdot Travel。 全部七个阶段单元均通过，每一项完成门槛也都达标，因此所请求的修复已落地。 受保护状态重放没有记录任何内容，因为本次运行中没有任何阶段断言过浏览器控制台。 未改动仓库通道则有记录：交付给求解器的仓库在控制台干净的状态下支撑了该路由，而修复落地后，交付的工作区便不再如此。

sents.zh: 全部七个阶段单元均通过，每一项完成门槛也都达标，因此所请求的修复已落地。

sents.zh: 受保护状态重放没有记录任何内容，因为本次运行中没有任何阶段断言过浏览器控制台。

sents.zh: 未改动仓库通道则有记录：交付给求解器的仓库在控制台干净的状态下支撑了该路由，而修复落地后，交付的工作区便不再如此。

paragraphs.en: What this establishes. This is a class-(a) regression, invisible to every channel except the second one: target-only scoring passes it because the requested repair is present, and replay cannot speak to it because it protects only what the run itself established. Only a gate suite run against the repository as handed to the solver can say that this property was working before and is not working now.
paragraphs.zh: 这确立了什么。 这是(a)类回归，除了第二个通道外，所有通道都无法察觉：仅针对目标评分会通过它，因为所要求的修复已经存在；而重放无法对此作出判断，因为它只保护运行本身所确立的内容。 只有针对交付给求解器的代码库运行的门禁测试套件，才能说明这一属性之前是有效的而现在不再有效。
